t.se8a71cba6a: Beep-beep! Hello, kids! I'm robot Kabu. Someone at the door said «meow», and someone said «woof». Who can it be? Let's find out!
t.sea9f7b7234: This is a cat. She says «meow-meow» and loves to drink milk. A cat has whiskers, and she walks very quietly.
t.sf2f6460f4b: This is a dog. He says «woof-woof» and guards our home. When he is happy, he wags his tail.
t.s2e5df88758: Great job! The cat drinks milk.
t.sbf7e48d0cf: Beep-beep! Today we're going to the village. There a big animal says «moo», and a soft animal says «baa». Can you guess who?
t.sc3516e5a54: This is a cow. She says «moo, moo». The yummy milk we drink comes from the cow. The cow eats green grass.
t.s5bf34800ab: This is a sheep. She says «baa-a-a». Her wool is soft, just like a cloud. Warm socks are knitted from wool.
t.s6a9e814ca6: Well done! The sheep has soft wool.
t.s29f6c8a2f4: Great job! The cow gives us milk.
t.sd0af6b0412: Beep-beep! Clip-clop, clip-clop… What's that sound? Someone is running to us fast! Let's take a look.
t.s23e2e2e2f4: Let's run like a horse: clip-clop!
t.s6549bedfd4: This is a horse. She says «neigh» and runs very fast. Her hooves go «clip-clop».
t.se5182a73be: This is a goat. She says «baa-a-a». The goat has little horns and a little beard. She gives milk too.
t.s8dcd459608: Game time! I name an animal, and you move like it. Horse — we run! Cat — we walk quietly! Sheep — we say «baa»!
t.s257032fa82: That's right! The horse runs fast.
t.s0c1383301b: Great job! The goat has a little beard.
t.s80394ea3d7: Beep-beep! Some animals don't make any sounds, but they are very sweet. One hops, and one swims in the water. Who are they?
t.sb2cac1c6c5: This is a bunny. He has long, long ears! The bunny goes «hop-hop» and loves to munch carrots.
t.sf3923fc8f4: This is a fish. She lives in a fish tank, in the water. The fish swims by wiggling her tail, but she makes no sound.
t.s690334a2b4: Do you have a cat, a dog or a fish at home or in the yard? Look together with your mom: what does it eat, how does it move? Tell robot Kabu tomorrow!
t.sb6a026f1a3: That's right! The bunny has long ears.
t.s64892c9a07: Well done! The fish swims in the water.
t.s1347b4f20e: Great job! The bunny eats carrots.
t.s8cb8fb76b2: Beep-beep! Morning is here. Someone in the yard crowed loudly and woke everyone up. Who can it be?
t.s0bc94019d6: This is a hen. She says «cluck-cluck-cluck» and pecks at grain. The hen lays eggs for us.
t.s2e79ee1d80: This is a rooster. He has a red comb on his head. In the morning the rooster crows «cock-a-doodle-doo!» and wakes everyone up.
t.sa4fc5534e0: Rooster, rooster, comb so red! Cock-a-doodle-doo, get out of bed! Let's sing together and flap our wings!
t.s5bcbf6fd3f: Who wakes everyone up in the morning?
t.s64626af13f: That's right! The rooster crows in the morning.
t.s673cf23371: Well done! The hen lays eggs.
t.s3e9fc88a07: Beep-beep! I'll tell you a secret: someone is hiding inside an egg. Tap-tap-tap… Who hatched?
t.s384fc8907e: This is an egg. It is white and round. The hen sits on the egg and keeps it warm.
t.s79dcbd5501: This is a chick. It hatches from an egg! The chick is bright yellow and fluffy and says «cheep-cheep». It runs after its mother hen.
t.s96a48015a1: Game time! Squat down and hug your knees — you are an egg. When I say «hatch!», slowly stand up and say «cheep-cheep». You are a chick!
t.sf4547186e2: That's right! A chick hatches from an egg.
t.sac4276c2c9: Great job! The chick's mother is the hen.
t.sd3cfe1f89b: Beep-beep! By the pond someone is saying «quack-quack». And next to it stands a big bird with its tail spread out like a fan. Shall we look?
t.s18a3cc5a92: This is a duck. She says «quack-quack» and loves to swim in the water. Her feet look like paddles.
t.s6693485f01: This is a turkey. He is a big bird and says «gobble-gobble». The turkey spreads his tail like a fan and struts around proudly.
t.sac3eb8e182: Ducks are swimming in the pond: one, two, three! Let's count on our fingers: one, two, three! Three little ducks — quack-quack-quack!
t.s8a69a60308: Who swims in the water and says «quack-quack»?
t.sc381676be9: Whose tail is big like a fan?
t.sbad12eac57: Well done! The turkey has a big tail.
t.sddec45d2b5: Great job! The duck is a farm bird.
t.s294319402b: Beep-beep! There are trees in the garden, and something yummy is hanging on the branches. Red and green… What can it be?
t.sa431ea9200: This is an apple. It is round and red. When you bite an apple, it goes «crunch!» — so sweet! An apple grows on a tree.
t.sd8b67ad910: This is a pear. It looks like an apple, but it is wider at the bottom and narrow at the top. A pear is so juicy, the juice drips down.
t.s379f01110d: Wash an apple and a pear with your mom and taste a piece of each. Which one goes «crunch-crunch»? Which one is juicier? Both are sweet!
t.s8e17cf1526: That's right! This is a red apple.
t.s24ba8996ce: Well done! This is a pear.
t.s6335c237ba: Great job! An apple grows on a tree.
t.s87838a599f: Beep-beep! What fruit does the little monkey love most? It is long and yellow! Let's find out.
t.sd918fb605d: Let's peel a banana — with our hands!
t.s0c47c1b0ae: This is a banana. It is long and bright yellow. Before we eat a banana, we peel off the skin. Inside it is soft and sweet.
t.sf3263865a9: These are grapes. They are tiny and grow together in one bunch. Grapes can be green or dark.
t.s2613e2c825: Which fruit is long and yellow?
t.sc653c9d993: That's right! The banana is long and yellow.
t.s9dc0048b40: Which fruit has lots of little berries?
t.s563ed626d4: Well done! Grapes have lots of little berries.
t.sa3e98b766a: Great job! We peel the banana.
t.s94a7c5ed5c: Beep-beep! In summer, two big heavy fruits ripen in the melon field. One is red inside, the other smells wonderful. Come on, guess!
t.s98dbc5cff7: This is a watermelon. It is green on the outside, and bright red inside with black seeds. A watermelon is sweet and juicy and quenches your thirst in summer.
t.scd565aa95b: This is a melon. It is yellow and smells wonderful. Bring it close to your nose — it smells yummy. The melon ripens in summer too.
t.s683321b732: A watermelon is big, and a grape is small. Big — we open our arms wide! Small — we bring our fingers close together. Come on, show me!
t.sdf4360b6bf: That's right! A watermelon is red inside.
t.sbfed9f4dae: Which fruit smells sweet and is yellow?
t.sa05de8ae75: Well done! A melon smells sweet.
t.s74079fa857: Great job! Watermelon seeds are black.
t.s9af64e9502: Beep-beep! One fruit is so sour that it makes us squeeze our eyes shut! Which one is it? Let's find out.
t.s4cf6fa38e9: This is a peach. Its skin is soft, just like velvet. Inside it has a big pit. A peach is sweet and smells nice.
t.sc8649e0347: This is a cherry. It is small, bright red and often hangs in pairs. Cherries are the first to ripen, at the end of spring.
t.s56bcc64911: This is a lemon. It is yellow, but not sweet — it's sour! When we eat a lemon, our face scrunches up. We put lemon in tea.
t.s0d8875ae6c: Remember: we always wash fruit in water before eating it! Splish-splash, now the fruit is clean. Now we can eat it!
t.se17e1649fe: That's right! A lemon is sour.
t.s4f986e819f: Well done! Cherries hang in pairs.
t.sbd31d2cc7e: Great job! A peach has soft skin.
t.s7dfa580718: Beep-beep! Some vegetables hide and grow under the ground. Pull them — and out they come! Who are they?
t.s7bf1a82cb0: Let's pull out the carrot: oof!
t.sd9aa670c14: This is a carrot. It is orange and long, and it grows under the ground. On top it has green leaves. Bunnies love carrots, and so do we!
t.s95f18ee52c: This is a potato. It also grows under the ground. We don't eat potatoes raw — we cook them first. Fried potatoes are so yummy!
t.s2be6b6ac6e: Game time! A big carrot is stuck in the ground. Let's all pull together: one, two, three — oof! It's out! Let's clap our hands!
t.s7148f4f7d9: That's right! This is a carrot.
t.s1e40a3ae3e: Well done! This is a potato.
t.s50048133a0: Great job! A carrot grows under the ground.
t.s181cf260fa: Beep-beep! We need two vegetables for a salad: one red and one green. Which ones? Let's find out!
t.sa2cde38da9: This is a tomato. It is bright red and round. A tomato is juicy: bite it and the juice comes out. We make salad with it.
t.s6877213531: This is a cucumber. It is green and long. When you bite a cucumber, it goes «crunch-crunch»! We put cucumber in salad.
t.se71f747bd2: Role-play: you're the chef! Put in the tomato — one! Put in the cucumber — two! Stir it up — swish-swish! The salad is ready, enjoy your meal!
t.s6ad15b9aeb: That's right! A tomato is red.
t.s8c3f959062: Well done! A cucumber is green.
t.sd2744fcfe6: What do we put in a salad?
t.s3e06ce7128: Great job! We put a tomato in the salad.
t.sc3707e1a82: Beep-beep! When we cut one vegetable, tears come from our eyes! Another one has leaves in layers. Who are they?
t.sf1c261b4a6: This is an onion. When we cut it, our eyes sting. An onion is sharp, but it makes food very tasty.
t.se7bdc76265: This is a cabbage. It is big and round, with leaves wrapped in layers. We make soup and salad from cabbage.
t.s5cfddbb21e: Which vegetable makes your eyes sting?
t.s170c3ddeb0: That's right! An onion makes your eyes sting.
t.s931963e97b: Which vegetable is big, with green leaves in layers?
t.sff1bb54200: Great job! A carrot is a vegetable.
t.s5f0c18e779: Beep-beep! Look, everything around us is so colorful! Today we'll learn two happy colors. What color was the apple?
t.s83f16aef9e: This is the color red. An apple is red, a tomato is red, and a cherry is red too! Is there anything else red around you?
t.se48bd2f26c: This is the color yellow. A banana is yellow, a lemon is yellow, and a chick is bright yellow! The sun shines with yellow light too.
t.s22ee0269cf: That's right! The apple is red.
t.s7b90b58ec3: Well done! The banana is yellow.
t.s6c59d54fa8: Great job! The chick is yellow.
t.sff705a566b: Beep-beep! I fly in the sky — what color is the sky? Down below there's grass — what color is it? Let's find out!
t.seaafa1c652: This is the color green. Grass is green, leaves are green, and a cucumber is green too! In spring everything turns green, green, green.
t.s5a075540b2: Do this with a grown-up: mix yellow paint with blue paint. Oh, what happened? It turned green! Magic!
t.s8b38219564: That's right! The grass is green.
t.s8943fff10f: Well done! The sky is blue.
t.sc59ba6d693: Great job! The cucumber is green.
t.sfb674a8bb5: Beep-beep! What color is snow? And the night? Today we'll learn two colors that are total opposites.
t.sa1a08f47c7: This is the color white. Milk is white, an egg is white, and snow is snowy white! A sheep's wool is white too.
t.sbc02e69669: Close your eyes — it's all dark!
t.sc49a975271: This is the color black. At night the sky is pitch black. Watermelon seeds are black too. And there are black cats!
t.s07f7ba12e6: What is the sky like at night?
t.s9eaa2a7419: Well done! At night the sky is black.
t.sf867514daf: Great job! The egg is white.
t.s7b23866881: Beep-beep! After the rain, a colorful bridge appears in the sky. What is it called? Let's find out!
t.se4cd2ee3af: This is the color orange. A carrot is orange, and an orange is orange too! This color is between red and yellow.
t.s90307fc45c: Draw a rainbow in the air with your hand!
t.sdd47e958b6: This is a rainbow. It appears in the sky after the rain, when the sun comes out. A rainbow has red, yellow, green, blue — lots of colors!
t.sf290854fa0: Red — an apple, yellow — a banana, green — the grass, blue — the sky! All together — a rainbow! Let's clap and sing!
t.s3d331510ce: That's right! A carrot is orange.
t.s580a9bf62f: What is the colorful bridge in the sky?
t.s873d2710bc: Great job! A rainbow appears after the rain.
t.s7141efe3c2: Beep-beep! Who warms us from the sky in the daytime? And who gives us light at night? Let's find out!
t.s323003554e: Spread your arms wide like the sun!
t.s92385e7332: This is the sun. It comes out in the daytime and warms everyone. When the sun shines, everything is bright. We never look straight at the sun — it hurts our eyes!
t.sbdbbff0c1c: Close your eyes like you're sleeping!
t.s8032d789fe: This is the moon. It comes out in the sky at night. When the moon is out, it's time to sleep. Sometimes the moon is round, and sometimes it's thin like a sickle.
t.sa18e4f9ed6: Game time! When I say «Sun!» — you jump and play. When I say «Moon!» — you crouch down like you're sleeping. Ready? Sun! … Moon!
t.sbbd4ec8929: What is in the sky in the daytime?
t.sa7dec778e2: That's right! The sun comes out in the daytime.
t.sf68594d8c2: What comes out in the sky at night?
t.sf97b331ad5: Well done! The moon comes out at night.
t.sdbf2c680ac: Great job! The sun keeps us warm.
t.sf94bf0c175: Beep-beep! Gray cotton balls floated across the sky. Pitter-patter-pat… Drops are falling! What's happening?
t.s10fa06cb20: This is a cloud. It floats in the sky and looks like white cotton. When a cloud turns dark, it will rain.
t.sda5bb93227: Tap your fingers on the table: pitter-pat!
t.s2ed635a02a: This is rain. It falls from a cloud drop by drop: pitter-patter-pat! Rain gives water to flowers and trees.
t.s43b9afc38c: This is an umbrella. When it rains, we open an umbrella and stay dry. An umbrella is like a little roof over us!
t.se822ef1e5f: When it rains, look out the window: how are the drops running down the glass? After the rain, look at the sky — maybe a rainbow will come out!
t.s244ec38fca: That's right! Rain comes from a cloud.
t.s94a59bc5bb: What do we hold when it rains?
t.s2b8b99bf27: Well done! We hold an umbrella.
t.sc425051f0b: Beep-beep! In winter, light white flakes fly down from the sky. They melt in your hand. What are they?
t.s2e4b54cad7: This is snow. It falls in winter, snowy white and very cold. When we walk on snow, it goes «crunch-crunch». In your hand it melts and turns into water.
t.s1bd4d98b27: This is a snowman. We roll a big snowball and a small one and put one on top of the other. Add a carrot for a nose — and it's done!
t.s23de178192: With a grown-up: put a little snow or ice on a saucer and leave it indoors. Then look — what happened? The snow melted and turned into water!
t.sd9d198d805: That's right! Snow is snowy white.
t.s451e5dfa0e: Well done! His nose is a carrot.
t.s7f2386a60f: Beep-beep! The leaves on the trees are rustling, and I'm almost blown away! Something is blowing, but we can't see it. What is it?
t.scf46a9bccc: Blow «whoosh» on your palm to make wind!
t.s37dd7cf3e3: This is the wind. We can't see it, but we can feel it! The wind blows «whoo-whoo», carries leaves and messes up our hair.
t.s95a86230bc: This is a kite. When the wind blows, the kite rises into the sky and flies. We hold the kite by its string.
t.sa8bb0605c7: Put a little piece of paper on the table. Now blow «whoosh»! The paper flew away — you made wind! Blow again softly, and then hard!
t.s09965b3d7d: Well done! A kite flies in the wind.
t.sc79ece3de9: What do we need when it rains?
t.sd3101b10fb: Great job! We need an umbrella when it rains.
t.s2a29a96dbb: Beep-beep! My home is in a tree. Where is your home? How do we get inside a house? Let's find out!
t.s450d38cdc1: Make a roof with your hands!
t.sa3f9f3cd5d: This is a house. We live in a house with our family. At home it's warm and safe. The roof keeps the rain out.
t.s79e4143a3c: This is a door. We go into the house through the door. First we knock «knock-knock», then we open it. And when we go out, we close it.
t.sa6bf5038d0: This is a window. Sunlight comes in through the window. We look out the window to see if it's raining or snowing outside.
t.s65054f762f: Role-play: knock-knock! — Who's there? — It's me, robot Kabu! — Come in, please! Now you knock, and I'll open the door!
t.s72b4ef3cce: That's right! We live in a house.
t.s7b2afb8698: How do we get into the house?
t.s25e20170c4: Well done! We go in through the door.
t.s8d32cbbc5d: What does sunlight come in through?
t.s264bfedb28: Great job! Sunlight comes in through the window.
t.s54537f3fe7: Beep-beep! Where do we sleep at night? What do we sit on when we eat? Let's get to know the things in our home!
t.s8440234b3a: Pretend to lay your head on a pillow!
t.s0de71f7574: This is a bed. At night we sleep in bed with our head on a pillow. We cover ourselves with a soft blanket.
t.s8f3c19cb7a: This is a chair. We sit on it. A chair has four legs, but it can't walk! When we eat, we sit nicely on a chair.
t.s30f6900260: That's right! We sleep in a bed.
t.s5d4b277648: Well done! We sit on a chair.
t.sc1ccadc4a5: Great job! At night the moon comes out, and we go to sleep.
t.s01473523dd: Beep-beep! Something smells yummy in the kitchen! What do we need to eat? Let's look at the table.
t.se6944a583a: Pretend to eat with a spoon!
t.sdb6572b89f: This is a spoon. We eat soup and porridge with a spoon. We hold the spoon in our right hand.
t.s1dea662e32: This is a tea bowl. We drink tea from it. When guests come, we pour tea into the bowl and hand it over with both hands.
t.sb8cb997343: This is a teapot. Grown-ups make tea in it. The teapot is hot, so we don't touch it!
t.secbce980bd: Role-play: a doll came to visit! Pour tea from the teapot into the bowl — glug-glug! Hand it over with both hands: «Here you are!» Well done!
t.sf2114f3ab5: What do we eat soup with?
t.s3baf330402: That's right! We eat it with a spoon.
t.sbc80cb2180: What do we drink tea from?
t.sb865e5054e: Well done! We drink from a tea bowl.
t.s83d7eae9a4: The teapot is hot. Do we touch it?
t.sfdb412326b: Great job! We don't touch a hot teapot.
t.s68cb148e61: This is a hand. With our hands we hold things, draw and clap. A hand has five fingers!
t.s886fdddd8d: This is a foot. With our feet we walk, run and jump. A foot has five toes too!
t.se8657bdf1d: Close your eyes and open them!
t.s5d3ebda350: This is an eye. With our eyes we see colors, the sun, and our mom! We don't rub our eyes.
t.se37fd10492: This is an ear. With our ears we hear a cat's «meow» and the rain's «pitter-pat»! We never put anything in our ears.
t.sfb32ba1079: Song and moves! Here are my eyes, here are my ears! Hands go clap-clap! Feet go stomp-stomp! One more time, faster!
t.s71c0cf52cc: That's right! We see with our eyes.
t.s088d056654: Well done! We hear with our ears.
t.s0f586dabdf: Great job! We jump with our feet.
t.sbf6ad3148f: Beep-beep! We played outside, and our hands got dirty. What do we do before eating? Let's learn!
t.s508cbd7e3c: This is soap. When we rub our hands with soap, white foam appears. The foam washes away dirt and germs.
t.s945bfb7b0a: This is a tap. When we turn on the tap, water flows — splish-splash! We rinse off the foam, then turn off the tap.
t.s66350acb4f: Here are clean hands! We always wash our hands before eating, after coming in from outside and after using the toilet.
t.s18cb03f9fa: What do we wash our hands with?
t.s9d26c1d690: That's right! We wash them with soap.
t.s85f7480263: When do we wash our hands?
t.sa53a99def6: Well done! We wash them before eating.
t.sc7d1135076: Where does the water come from?
t.sda4ce9b984: Great job! Water comes from the tap.
t.s46be1e3ac3: Beep-beep! When we laugh, something white shines. What is it? How do we keep it clean? Let's find out!
t.s87329031fc: These are teeth. With our teeth we bite an apple — «crunch»! — and chew our food. We need to take care of our teeth!
t.s90964c359b: Pretend to brush your teeth: brush-brush!
t.s8152d03faf: This is a toothbrush. Morning and evening we brush our teeth with it: up and down, brush-brush!
t.se15d351e84: This is a bathtub. We take a bath in warm water. After a bath our body is clean and smells nice. Playing in the bubbles is so much fun!
t.sd986821110: What do we brush our teeth with?
t.s570b705131: Where do we take a bath?
t.s6be5f503c4: Well done! We take a bath in the bathtub.
t.sb08811ab51: What do we do with our teeth?
t.s95ea57cf75: Great job! We chew with our teeth.
t.sd33105742c: Beep-beep! Some animals live with people, and others live on their own in the forest. Who lives where? Let's find out!
t.s039ee80d9a: Farm and home animals live near people. People feed them, and they help us: a cow gives milk, a dog guards the house.
t.sa52fddd327: Wild animals live on their own in the forest, the mountains or the fields. They find their own food. We don't go near them!
t.s0e43f89a52: Game time! I'll name an animal. If it lives with people — make a roof with your hands. If it's wild — raise your arms like a tree! Dog… Cow…
t.s76739c2df2: That's right! A cow lives with people.
t.s43b8f6afeb: Well done! A wild animal finds its own food.
t.s9c5a474a14: Great job! A dog guards the house.
t.sf221b79a2f: Beep-beep! I flew over the forest and saw three wild animals. One is big, one is gray, and one is sly. Who are they?
t.s7b1a04b46e: This is a bear. It is big and strong and roars «grr-grr». A bear loves honey and berries.
t.see25fd70ee: This is a wolf. It is gray with a long tail. At night it looks at the moon and howls «ow-ow-ooo». Wolves move around in a pack.
t.s483fd54e61: This is a fox. It is reddish, with a fluffy, beautiful tail. In fairy tales the fox is always sly!
t.sd56798c04b: That's right! The bear loves honey.
t.s5bfa37d613: Who has a fluffy red tail?
t.s1272c46291: Great job! This is a fox.
t.s81f1d3c562: Beep-beep! All animals have babies. What do we call a cow's baby? Let's find out!
t.s2bdd7d91d6: This is a calf, a cow's baby. It drinks its mother's milk and calls «moo». When a calf grows up, it becomes a cow.
t.s622e276f3a: This is a lamb, a sheep's baby. It is very small and soft, and says «baa» in a tiny voice.
t.s33a805e885: This is a puppy, a dog's baby. It is playful, barks «woof» and chases a ball.
t.s6122fa1518: This is a foal, a horse's baby. It has long, long legs. Soon after it is born, a foal stands up and starts to walk!
t.s0cd4287313: Game time! I say the baby, you say its mom. Calf — … cow! Puppy — … dog! Lamb — … sheep! Foal — … horse! Well done!
t.s8338f3e1df: That's right! The cow's baby is a calf.
t.sc73c805f7a: Well done! The dog's baby is a puppy.
t.s1401e561d0: Great job! The horse's baby is a foal.
t.s394303ef24: Beep-beep! Today we're going to the zoo. There are animals from hot countries there. Who will we see?
t.s8f018136fb: This is a lion. We call him «the king of animals». A lion has a thick mane on his head, and he roars «r-r-r».
t.s95c4fc4dbe: Make a trunk with your arm!
t.scc82d36ab8: This is an elephant. It is the biggest animal on land! An elephant has a long trunk. It uses it to drink water and take a shower.
t.s73da166cfa: This is a monkey. It jumps from tree to tree and happily says «oo-oo-ah-ah». A monkey loves to eat bananas.
t.s9db615a058: Action game: let's be elephants — heavy steps, swing the trunk! Let's be monkeys — jump! Let's be lions — r-r-r! Super!
t.sf1dfc17060: That's right! The elephant has a long trunk.
t.s3cb20b2f1a: Who is the king of animals?
t.s179752e30e: Well done! The lion is the king of animals.
t.s9a304cff32: Great job! A monkey eats bananas.
t.sc30782a960: This is a sparrow. It is small and grey-brown. It hops around, says «tweet-tweet» and pecks at seeds.
t.s8b97a6b33b: This is an owl. It has big, big eyes. An owl sleeps in the day, and at night it flies and says «hoo-hoo».
t.sdb8b4c6e9a: My wings go flap-flap, up to the sky! Tweet-tweet — sparrow, coo-coo — pigeon, hoo-hoo — owl! Flap your arms like wings and sing!
t.sa887ce9e83: Well done! The owl flies at night.
t.sfd46ec65eb: What does a bird fly with?
t.se8ccd7c26b: Great job! A bird flies with its wings.
t.se8453b7ba3: Beep-beep! In spring, birds build a little house from twigs and grass. There's a secret inside! What can it be?
t.s42019e9730: This is a nest, a bird's home. The bird builds it with its beak from twigs, grass and feathers. The nest sits on a tree branch.
t.s20514e2936: This is an egg. A bird lays eggs in the nest, sits on them and keeps them warm. Then a tiny chick hatches out of the egg!
t.sa70c1d9d59: Float down slowly like a feather!
t.s37aabe10a5: This is a feather. A bird's body is covered with feathers. Feathers are light and soft, and they keep the bird safe from the cold.
t.s4c5ba5aa5a: On a walk, look at the trees: can you see a nest? We don't touch the nest or scare the birds — we only look from far away!
t.s6c7d0e5f91: That's right! The nest is on a tree branch.
t.s7cd8491a44: Well done! A chick hatches from the egg.
t.s1e8c3fa825: Great job! Feathers keep the bird warm.
t.sd8db95a1c5: Beep-beep! I can't go into the water, but there is life under the water too! Who lives in the water? Let's dive in!
t.s0b9b73eb9f: This is a fish. It lives in rivers and lakes. A fish swims with its fins and tail. It can't live out of the water.
t.s300757a3e5: This is a whale. It lives in the sea and is very, very big, even bigger than an elephant! A whale sprays a fountain of water from the top of its head.
t.sf3f945a7e7: This is a dolphin. It lives in the sea and is very smart and cheerful. A dolphin leaps out of the water to play and squeaks.
t.sf4252c6129: Game time! I say a name: if it's a bird — flap your wings, if it lives in water — move your arms like you're swimming. Sparrow! Whale! Owl! Dolphin!
t.sba4d52eb91: That's right! A fish lives in water.
t.s767f0a7ef1: Who is the biggest animal in the sea?
t.s81153112c7: Well done! The biggest one is the whale.
t.s0650cb464e: Who jumps out of the water to play?
t.s491c211dba: Great job! The dolphin jumps and plays.
t.s7b1a7721c2: Beep-beep! Uncle Gardener is putting things picked from the trees into a basket. They are sweet and smell nice. What are they?
t.sa3781acfe0: Fruits grow on trees or bushes. They are usually sweet. Apples, pears, apricots — they're all fruits!
t.sc2bc6627c2: This is an orange. It is orange and has a thick peel. Inside, it has juicy segments. Oranges grow on trees in hot countries.
t.sad39b24e4f: These are grapes. They grow on a vine in bunches. If we dry grapes, we get raisins!
t.sb8e8484d0a: That's right! Fruits grow on trees.
t.s6daa006b36: What do we get if we dry grapes?
t.s3b3fbcc809: Great job! An orange is a fruit.
t.sf2a24aabcc: Beep-beep! Now let's go to the vegetable garden. Things there grow on the ground or under it. We make soup from them. What are they?
t.s5318ef6ea0: Vegetables grow in the garden, on the ground or under it. We make soup, salad and plov from them. A carrot is a vegetable!
t.s850151df19: This is a potato. It hides and grows under the ground. We dig potatoes up, cook them and eat them.
t.s0f764461dd: This is a tomato. It grows on a small plant. First it is green, then it turns red in the sun and gets ripe.
t.s49c74bead8: That's right! Potatoes grow under the ground.
t.s5aa357ed28: Well done! A carrot is a vegetable.
t.s9c4454cf9e: What color is a ripe tomato?
t.s68a41dfa48: Great job! A ripe tomato is red.
t.s284a9bb280: Beep-beep! Oh no, the fruits and vegetables got all mixed up! There are two baskets. Will you help me sort them?
t.sd4f3b2b611: This is a strawberry. It grows low, close to the ground, but it is sweet — so we call it a fruit! It gets ripe in spring.
t.s3b3e2a54f0: This is a cucumber. It grows in the vegetable garden, it's green and crunchy. A cucumber is a vegetable, we put it in salad.
t.se646f201a6: This is a bell pepper. It can be green, red or yellow. It is hollow inside and has seeds. It is a vegetable.
t.s3bbdfd082f: Game time! Left hand — the fruit basket, right hand — the vegetable basket. I say a word, you raise your hand: apple! potato! grapes! cucumber! orange!
t.s7e1d0aa5e8: Is a strawberry a fruit or a vegetable?
t.s6c61bb94ee: That's right! A strawberry is a fruit.
t.s926a316d91: Is a cucumber a fruit or a vegetable?
t.sbb5b9b5272: Well done! A cucumber is a vegetable.
t.s8b4467e676: Great job! A strawberry is a fruit.
t.s6488735d47: Beep-beep! Some days we get all sweaty, some days we shiver. Why is that? Let's learn about hot and cold!
t.s117ada779b: On a hot day, the sun shines very warm, we sweat and want to drink water. Hot tea and soup are hot too!
t.s622be06208: On a cold day, our hands get frozen and we shiver: brrr-brrr-brrr! Ice cream and snow are cold too.
t.s06223d6a4c: With a grown-up: pour warm water into one glass and cold water into another. Touch with your finger: which one is warm, which one is cold? We never touch very hot water!
t.sb36b84f09d: When the sun shines warm, what is it like?
t.s87c7f451e6: That's right! When the sun shines warm, it's hot.
t.s133163b8e9: What do we do when it's hot?
t.sa0cf5a4ad2: Great job! When it's hot, we drink water.
t.sc95d5b4b1c: Beep-beep! In the morning we look out the window: what is the sky like? What kind of day is it? Let's check the weather!
t.se5108c9f0e: On a sunny day, the sky is clear and bright blue. Everything is light and warm. A great day for a walk!
t.s6d6d6f33bc: On a cloudy day, the sun hides behind the clouds. The sky is grey and it gets cooler. Maybe it will rain!
t.s0157ccfcb3: Look at the sky every morning. If it's sunny — draw ☀️, if it's cloudy — draw ☁️. At the end of the week we'll count: which days were there more of?
t.s48f7dc6d89: The sky is clear and bright — what kind of day is it?
t.s79136b32ed: The sun is behind a cloud — what kind of day is it?
t.s148a963b4d: Great job! A sunny day is warmer.
t.s5b3ecdf6cb: Beep-beep! Sometimes drops of water fall from a cloud, and sometimes snow-white flakes. Then water gathers on the ground. What are these?
t.s1267db369c: Rain is drops of water falling from a cloud: drip-drip-drip! Rain gives water to the ground, the flowers and the trees.
t.sa6c1df16ff: When it is very cold, snow falls from the cloud instead of rain. Every snowflake looks like a little star!
t.sdaa823c4b9: After rain, water gathers on the ground — that's a puddle. If we wear boots, we can go through a puddle: «splash»! Let's keep our feet dry!
t.s6b0094544b: What falls from the cloud when it's very cold?
t.s6c19e5d04f: That's right! When it's cold, it snows.
t.s66e61c7e10: What appears on the ground after rain?
t.s8199edc37b: Who does the rain give water to?
t.s60b5249806: Great job! Rain gives water to the flowers.
t.s2f1a0aad45: Beep-beep! What happens if we go out in a thin T-shirt in winter? Or wear a warm jacket in summer? Let's dress the right way!
t.se47df2e1a4: Pretend to put on a jacket!
t.sa19b51b874: This is a jacket. On a cold day we wear a jacket, it keeps us warm. We do up the buttons or the zipper all the way.
t.s5eb0564ce0: These are mittens. In winter we wear mittens so our hands don't freeze. It's fun to play in the snow with mittens!
t.sfdfdcc407a: Put a sun hat on your head!
t.s7d03ffd075: This is a sun hat. In summer we wear a sun hat so the sun doesn't make our head too hot. We never go out in the heat without a sun hat!
t.s28161ea26f: Pretend play: it's snowing outside! What shall we put on the doll? A jacket, mittens! Now the sun is hot — let's put on a sun hat!
t.s75ab905b3f: What do we wear when it's cold?
t.s0e2c73a7da: That's right! When it's cold, we wear a jacket.
t.s90d6bba33a: What do we wear on our head when it's hot?
t.s8154230f22: Well done! When it's hot, we wear a sun hat.
t.sf23d8ad48c: Great job! We need mittens when it's cold.
t.sf83357b46a: Beep-beep! The trees put on yellow and red clothes, and the leaves are dancing down to the ground. What season is here?
t.s3770dc09c0: Autumn is here! It gets cool, and it often rains. The leaves turn yellow and red. Children go to kindergarten and school.
t.s8d4655b0c3: Spin and fall like a leaf!
t.s6365a2db87: In autumn, leaves come off the trees and fall to the ground. When we walk on them, they go «crunch-crunch».
t.s45825124df: In autumn we gather the harvest from the orchard and the garden: apples, grapes, potatoes, pumpkins. The baskets are full!
t.seb84d83889: On a walk, collect leaves of different colors: yellow, red, brown. At home, glue them onto paper and make a pretty autumn picture!
t.s95ecab589c: What happens to the leaves in autumn?
t.s8d21693231: That's right! In autumn the leaves turn yellow.
t.s7c9eb107ac: What do we gather in autumn?
t.se3d9f39f72: Well done! In autumn we gather the harvest.
t.s3382f7f818: What sound do leaves make when we walk on them?
t.sc254765de5: Beep-beep! Everything has turned white, and icy patterns have appeared on the windows. What season is here?
t.s8b819c9671: Winter is the coldest season. It snows, and everything is white. The days are short and the nights are long.
t.sed155bd96c: In winter, water freezes from the cold and turns into ice. Ice is slippery! We walk carefully on ice.
t.s955d69bba0: This is a sled. In winter we slide down the hill on a sled: «whoosh»! So much fun!
t.s5366824692: Do it with a grown-up: pour water into a small bowl and put it in the freezer. Look the next day — the water froze and turned into ice! Now put it somewhere warm — it will melt again.
t.s7ca4adfdd9: That's right! Winter is the coldest season.
t.s279d5b5655: What does water turn into when it's cold?
t.s3f37e6cdb3: Well done! Water turns into ice.
t.sef4ee6a720: What do we ride on in winter?
t.s1bef070927: Beep-beep! The snow has melted, the sun shines warm, the birds are singing. What season has woken up?
t.sfa1e7fc953: Spring is here! The snow melts and it gets warm. Trees bloom, and birds come back from warm countries. In spring we have the Navruz holiday!
t.sf4bad3e07e: In spring, young green grass comes up from the ground. Everything looks like a bright green carpet.
t.s79c347616b: In spring, warm rain falls. Then, when the sun comes out, a colorful rainbow appears in the sky!
t.sb23eb8d3f5: What comes up from the ground in spring?
t.s7ce7b2b34f: Which season is it — flowers bloom and snow melts?
t.s988da92f05: If the sun comes out after rain, what will we see?
t.sd3eaecb0c3: Great job! We'll see a rainbow.
t.s3c62cf2065: Beep-beep! The sun is very hot, the fruits are ripe in the garden, children are playing in the water. What season is it?
t.sa820177b9d: Summer is the hottest season. The days are long, and the sun sets late. Watermelons, melons and peaches get ripe. Children are on holiday!
t.sb5ecb2f666: In summer we swim in the pool and cool down. We only go into the water with a grown-up!
t.s8375ffed47: In summer we eat ice cream — it's cold and sweet! But we eat it little by little, so our throat doesn't hurt.
t.s50d7a1e097: In autumn leaves fall down, in winter snow is all around, in spring the flowers grow, in summer the sun is aglow! One clap for each season — one, two, three, four!
t.s1fea09a406: That's right! Summer is the hottest season.
t.sf2fac841f8: Who do we go into the water with?
t.s54ad89e9a5: Well done! Only with a grown-up.
t.sdae7f81802: What do we wear on our head in summer?
t.s3f866015dc: Great job! In summer we wear a sun hat.
t.s3bc5b15c9f: Beep-beep! I flew over a flower bed — what a lovely smell! There are all kinds of flowers there. Let's meet them!
t.s18d9cebaf3: This is a rose. It smells lovely and is very pretty. But its stem has thorns, so be careful — we don't touch!
t.s3e849a2955: This is a sunflower. It grows tall and turns its head toward the sun. Inside, it has seeds.
t.s45904a0481: This is a daisy. Its petals are snow-white, and its middle is bright yellow, like a little sun.
t.s9ca3501bb8: We don't pick flowers in the flower bed — let them grow! We just bend down and gently smell them. Which flower smells the best?
t.s66df9154c1: That's right! The rose has thorns.
t.s37af415b88: Which flower turns toward the sun?
t.sff2aab4362: What color is the middle of a daisy?
t.s1ebbfe62e9: Great job! The middle is yellow.
t.s14fe96e93f: Beep-beep! My home is in a tree! A tree is tall, and it has a trunk, branches and leaves. Let's take a closer look!
t.s763c68edc3: Raise your arms like a tree!
t.se50f3bdf17: This is a tree. It has a thick trunk, many branches and leaves. A tree gives us shade, fruit and fresh air.
t.se905df8dd9: This is a leaf. In summer leaves are green, and in autumn they turn yellow and fall. In the wind, leaves rustle.
t.sc6e59f4bca: This is a fir tree. Its leaves look like needles and don't fall even in winter — it's always green! At New Year we decorate the fir tree.
t.sbce343d406: Which tree stays green even in winter?
t.s5f23696b6e: That's right! The fir tree is always green.
t.s8328b5d0ce: What does a tree give us?
t.sbca7db0000: What happens to the leaves in autumn?
t.sb5783ec516: Great job! In autumn the leaves fall.
t.sa36bba0f87: Beep-beep! A little flower on the windowsill has wilted. How can we save it? What does it need? Let's find out!
t.s958d692dc0: Plants get thirsty too! We give them water — we water them. But not too much, just a little at a time.
t.s3966568558: A plant needs sunlight. That's why we put the flower pot by the window. In the dark, a plant wilts.
t.sd8006d03ec: This is a flowerpot. We put soil in it and plant a flower. At home, flowers grow in pots and make our room pretty.
t.s9ffdaf949a: Experiment: with a grown-up, choose one flower in a pot. Look at it every day and give it a little water if it needs some. After a week — is there a new leaf?
t.sb4660c80f0: If a plant is thirsty, what do we give it?
t.s26ad295ce5: That's right! We give the plant water.
t.s3ebb4f0849: Where do we put the flowerpot?
t.sc3caf65078: What does a flower grow in at home?
t.sec0a98c0c7: Beep-beep! Someone drove down the street going «beep-beep»! Some are big, some are small. What are they?
t.sf48e9008db: This is a car. It takes people places fast and honks «beep-beep». In the car, we sit in a seat.
t.se7a842189c: This is a truck. It is big and strong and carries heavy loads: furniture, boxes, fruit. It goes «vroom-vroom».
t.s962dc73967: Action game: everyone is a car! Hold the wheel and drive. When I say «fast!» — go fast, «slow!» — go slow, «stop!» — you stop!
t.sb85a205666: Great job! A car drives on the road.
t.s5cb2d9cfec: Beep-beep! Lots of people are waiting at the stop. Look, a big long vehicle has come! Everyone got on. What is it?
t.s726ce1efa6: This is a bus. It is long and big, and lots of people fit inside. The bus goes from stop to stop.
t.s4df7686e51: This is a bus stop. Here we wait for the bus. When the bus stops, we get on holding a grown-up's hand.
t.s922b9d9207: Call a taxi — raise your hand!
t.s666ce702d6: This is a taxi. If we call it, it takes us where we need to go. A taxi has a little light on its roof.
t.sc4765ff600: The wheels on the bus go round and round! The doors open — swish! They close — swish! The horn goes — beep-beep! Let's sing and move!
t.sce629e66be: Where do we wait for the bus?
t.s5defa9b883: That's right! We wait at the bus stop.
t.sff3ccb5002: Well done! A bus carries lots of people.
t.s434b6408e8: How do we call a taxi?
t.s72d8880ce7: Great job! We raise our hand.
t.s0e74d6dad8: Beep-beep! Choo-choo-choo! Something long, long, long is running along the rails. Who can it be? Let's look!
t.sf057a1df0f: This is a train. It has lots of cars, all hooked together. The train goes «choo-choo» to faraway cities.
t.sdf3a7a8874: These are rails, the train's road. A train only runs on rails. We never go near the rails — it's dangerous!
t.s66c288bf87: Game: hold each other's shoulders and be a train! The first one is the engine, the rest are cars. Choo-choo, off we go! A station — we stop!
t.sfa66e41b71: What does a train run on?
t.s131b3924ae: Well done! A train runs on rails.
t.s5054eb3d4f: Do we go near the rails?
t.sdd60e2a385: Great job! We don't go near the rails.
t.sb7750d7570: Beep-beep! I fly in the sky, but sometimes someone flies by even higher and faster than me! Whoosh… Who is it?
t.sf16d854b67: This is a plane. It has wings like me, but very big ones! The plane goes «whoosh» across the sky and takes people far away.
t.sb78cc08a95: Spin your arm like a propeller!
t.s17382e953c: This is a helicopter. A big propeller spins on top: whirr-whirr-whirr! A helicopter can hover in the air in one spot.
t.sfa575e839d: Game! If it goes on the road — put your hands down, if it flies in the sky — raise them up! Car! Plane! Bus! Helicopter! Train!
t.s62db87a407: That's right! A plane flies in the sky.
t.s19b2564196: Who has a propeller spinning on top?
t.s6d67db6fc1: Well done! A helicopter has a propeller.
t.sca01747b58: Great job! A bus drives on the road.
t.s2d839a9f9b: This is a doctor. The doctor helps us get better when we are sick. A doctor wears a white coat and is very kind.
t.s02df3494e0: This is a thermometer. The doctor uses it to check if our body is hot or not. If we have a fever, the thermometer will tell.
t.s0c5c4c2c84: Put your hand on your heart: thump-thump!
t.sd6f6c5c771: This is a stethoscope. The doctor puts it in their ears and listens to our heart: thump-thump, thump-thump!
t.s17a5f8ba2a: Pretend play: you are the doctor, the teddy bear is the patient. «Hello, what's wrong?» Listen to his heart — thump-thump! Take his temperature. «Get well soon!»
t.s0c1f17bbda: Who helps us when we are sick?
t.s20f8a514bc: What does the doctor use to listen to the heart?
t.s8f82ee0bb1: Beep-beep! A yummy smell of plov is coming from the kitchen! A person in a white hat is standing by the big pot. Who is it?
t.s514837dbd1: This is a cook. The cook makes tasty food. A cook wears a white hat and an apron and washes their hands before work.
t.s5204faba26: This is a kazan, a big cooking pot. The cook makes soup and plov in it. The kazan gets very hot — we don't touch it!
t.se26c0ab3b6: Pretend to eat with a spoon: mmm!
t.s6e122f4680: This is plov. It has rice, carrots, onions and meat in it. Everyone loves plov!
t.se171b3e25b: Pretend play: let's wash our hands! Put carrots, onions and rice in the kazan. Stir. The plov is ready! Let's serve our guests: «Enjoy your meal!»
t.se929dfb00e: That's right! The cook makes food.
t.s214f8fe1ae: Well done! Carrots go into plov.
t.s2672f9aba3: Do we touch a hot kazan?
t.sfc8fc151b8: Great job! We don't touch a hot kazan.
t.sdd9723a589: Beep-beep! Who drives the bus? The driver takes us to kindergarten, to the market and home. Let's meet them!
t.s2edbe47aab: This is a driver. The driver turns the wheel and drives a car or a bus. A driver watches the road carefully.
t.s58a668c923: This is a traffic light. Red light — we stop, green light — we go. The driver and we all follow the traffic light.
t.s81585948d2: A person riding the bus is a passenger. A passenger sits quietly, doesn't distract the driver and holds on to the handrail.
t.sc33fb48dfd: Game! When I show a red circle — freeze. When I show green — march in place! Red! … Green! … Red!
t.s5c2ea0517d: What do we do when the traffic light is red?
t.s6616e7f36b: Well done! On red, we stop.
t.s5c3da7e13b: And what do we do when it's green?
t.s16465db102: Great job! On green, we go.
t.s918bfe744a: Beep-beep! Hello, little explorers! I'm robot Kabu. In one year, nature changes its clothes four times. What are these four outfits called? Let's find out!
t.s9942736bec: Autumn is a cool season. Leaves turn yellow and red, and the harvest is picked in the gardens. In autumn, children go back to kindergarten and school.
t.sc797b850fe: Winter is the coldest season. Snow falls, water freezes, and we dress warmly. In winter we have the New Year holiday!
t.sf7353d6057: Spring is the season when nature wakes up. Snow melts, grass comes up, trees bloom. On March 21 we celebrate Navruz.
t.s8347e313d8: Summer is the hottest season. The sun is high, the days are long. Watermelons, melons and peaches get ripe, and children swim and rest.
t.s04c67e2693: Four seasons in a year, let's count them all right here: autumn — leaves, winter — snow, spring — flowers, summer — sun! Say each season and fold one finger: one, two, three, four!
t.s850cbe5341: In which season does it snow?
t.sad94d02f2c: That's right! It snows in winter.
t.s664e8a183b: Well done! Navruz is in spring, on March 21.
t.sc10b80a54e: Great job! Summer is the hottest season.
t.sef0e9dfc11: In which season do leaves turn yellow?
t.s7e37cb0e98: Very good! Leaves turn yellow in autumn.
t.s8dc84c1483: Beep-beep! Let's be explorers! Nature gives us signs that say «Autumn is here» or «Winter is here». What are the signs? Let's look for them!
t.sb376a40ff2: In autumn, trees drop their leaves. The leaves make a yellow-red carpet on the ground. Walk on it — crunch-crunch!
t.sf16b6b9c3b: In autumn, some birds — ducks, storks, cranes — fly away to warm lands. They fly across the sky in the shape of the letter «V».
t.sb9a9eb60ac: In winter, snow falls from the clouds. Every snowflake is a little star with six points! Everything turns all white.
t.sa557bf439d: In winter, days are short and nights are long. It gets dark outside even before dinner.
t.s1fc957a970: On your walk, be an explorer: are there many leaves on the tree or just a few? Are birds flying in the sky? At home, draw what you saw and tell robot Kabu!
t.s4064d82f5a: Where do birds fly in autumn?
t.s90bf0ad371: That's right! They fly away to warm lands.
t.seb73258265: Well done! Winter nights are long.
t.s4dac25ecf0: Leaves are falling — what season is it?
t.s5cd70724a5: Great job! That's a sign of autumn.
t.s8b4a6783ce: How many points does a snowflake have?
t.sfb1164046c: Very good! It's a little star with six points.
t.sda7709d430: Beep-beep! Winter fell asleep, and nature is waking up! What signs do spring and summer give? Open your eyes wide — let's look!
t.s0e5f6cd58d: In spring, the tiny buds on the branches open up into flowers and leaves. Apricot and cherry trees get covered in white and pink blossoms.
t.saab0ff668e: In spring, the birds that flew to warm lands come back. Swallows build nests, and birds sing in the gardens.
t.s2168f36ad5: In summer, the sun rises early and sets late, so the days are very long. It's light even in the evening — lots of time to play!
t.s89e07291a4: Reach up like you're picking fruit!
t.s16af932d08: In summer, cherries, apricots, peaches and watermelons get ripe. In the garden, the fruit gets sweet, sweet, sweet and waits for us.
t.sa4ec346d63: What comes out of buds in spring?
t.sc5e55ed951: Well done! Summer days are long.
t.s69421bed51: The cherries are ripe — which season's sign is that?
t.s7b36e9b5f7: Very good! That's a sign of summer.
t.s844a253628: Beep-beep! Want to hear a secret? The seasons never end — they go round in a circle and come back again! Which season comes after which?
t.sf6de33e6dc: Draw a circle with your hand!
t.sc450e7f801: The seasons take turns: after autumn comes winter, after winter — spring, after spring — summer, after summer — autumn again. This circle never stops!
t.sf8eb53614f: A calendar shows the months. There are 12 months in a year, and three months in each season. In which season is your birthday?
t.s5d97f418a0: We dress for each season: in winter — a scarf, a coat, mittens; in summer — light clothes and a sun hat; in autumn and spring — a light jacket.
t.sda14e4e801: Action game! I'll name a season: autumn — spin like a leaf; winter — shiver; spring — open up like a flower; summer — swim! Now in order, and faster!
t.sc86ac778d4: That's right! After winter comes spring.
t.s33455938dc: How many months are in one season?
t.s8abc871757: Well done! Each season has three months.
t.s94dcb03728: What do we wear in winter?
t.s1acca65dd3: Great job! In winter we wear a scarf.
t.s6b6b7b95ea: Very good! After summer comes autumn.
t.s052cd9b10b: Beep-beep! I have a little secret in my palm. It's tiny, but a whole plant is hiding inside! What is it?
t.scc1576fbe5: This is a seed. It's small, but a future plant is sleeping inside. If we plant the seed and water it, it wakes up and starts to grow!
t.s8941aeca9c: Pretend you're holding a seed in your palm!
t.s8201f1089c: We find seeds inside fruit! A watermelon has black seeds, an apple has small brown seeds, and an apricot has a big pit.
t.s80151edf8a: This is soil. We plant the seed in the soil. Soil holds the plant and feeds it.
t.s20841d81ce: With a grown-up, cut open an apple or a pepper. How many seeds are inside? Count them! Put the seeds on a little plate and look at them through a magnifying glass.
t.s36bf62dce4: What does a plant grow from?
t.s4103f57595: That's right! A plant grows from a seed.
t.sf8f6779191: Where do we plant a seed?
t.sa64e988a08: Great job! Watermelon seeds are black.
t.s87cc7b4f9f: Beep-beep! We eat, drink water and breathe. A plant is alive too! What does it need? Let's find out three secrets!
t.s95f1fe0ce4: A plant drinks water with its roots. Without water, the leaves wilt and droop. But too much water is bad too — the roots rot.
t.s25de6c3f8b: A plant needs light. A flower by the window turns its leaves toward the sun. In the dark, a plant turns pale and gets weak.
t.s8af834a115: A plant takes in air through its leaves. And it gives us fresh air too! That's why it's easy to breathe where there are lots of trees and flowers.
t.s23dc401711: With a grown-up: take two matching sprouts. Put one by the window and the other in a dark cupboard. After a week, compare: which one is greener?
t.s2d0cfb883f: What does a plant drink water with?
t.s25c00a229b: What happens to a plant in the dark?
t.s6d3eda5960: Well done! It gets weak in the dark.
t.s4fd4fa0604: Great job! A plant needs water.
t.saa90708123: Beep-beep! The seed woke up in the soil and poked out a tiny green head! Now it grows both down and up. How does it do that?
t.s3ccb2955db: This is a sprout, a young plant that comes from a seed. It pushes up through the soil and grows a little every day, reaching for the sun.
t.s7b6ad89d7b: The root grows down, under the ground. It holds the plant tight and drinks water. A carrot is a root too — and we eat it!
t.s2f4dc96963: Leaves grow up, toward the sun. They catch sunlight and give the plant strength. Leaves are usually green.
t.sa5aa5f0b22: Which way does a root grow?
t.se7fe611c03: That's right! A root grows down.
t.sd6a08b2d87: Well done! A carrot is a root.
t.s4cf3da65eb: What do we call a young plant from a seed?
t.s168d98532e: Beep-beep! Today we're real scientists! We'll grow a plant from a bean and watch it every day. Are you ready?
t.s3265bd7f68: An experiment is when we test things ourselves to find an answer. Today's question: how does a bean sprout? We'll do it together with a grown-up!
t.s25863d8c47: Observing means looking carefully. Every day we look at the bean: has it cracked? Is there a root? Is there a leaf?
t.s6f95a501ef: Scientists write down what they see. And we'll draw! If we draw the bean every day, we'll see how it grew.
t.s0501254612: 1) Put wet cotton wool or a napkin in a glass jar. 2) Place 2–3 beans against the side. 3) Put it in a bright spot and keep the cotton wet. In 3–4 days a root comes out, then a leaf!
t.s70194e1391: One drawing each day: day 1 — a bean, day 3 — a little root, day 6 — a leaf! If we put the drawings in order, we get the bean's whole story.
t.s1d53494cbc: What comes out of the bean first?
t.sdc1df425e5: That's right! First a root comes out.
t.se8bca29bb3: What is it called when you look carefully every day?
t.sfb52f8c443: What do we give the bean every day?
t.s36f463ccba: Beep-beep! Someone is flying over the flowers going «buzz-buzz». It's very hard-working and gives us a sweet present. Who is it?
t.s1547a3693e: This is a bee. It flies from flower to flower going «buzz-buzz». The bee works very hard! But it has a stinger — we don't grab a bee with our hands, we leave it alone.
t.sa985338fa1: A bee collects sweet nectar from flowers. As it flies from one flower to another, it carries pollen — and then the flowers make fruit!
t.s16e1da40d1: This is honey. Bees make honey from flower nectar in their hive. Honey is sweet and good for you, and we eat it with tea.
t.sdd3dfd923a: Action game: we're all bees! Make wings with your arms and fly around the room: «buzz-buzz». When I say «Flower!» — squat down and collect nectar. When I say «Hive!» — gather in one place!
t.sc4d3ca1de3: Do we grab a bee with our hands?
t.s2b190a2064: Well done! We leave the bee alone.
t.s386e0ea551: Great job! It collects nectar from flowers.
t.sbd628f1b37: Beep-beep! Do you believe in magic? A tiny crawling caterpillar one day turns into a beautiful butterfly with wings! How does it happen?
t.sdfbfb91a33: This is a caterpillar. It hatches from an egg, eats lots and lots of leaves and grows. Then it wraps itself in a cocoon and sleeps inside.
t.sb43930b272: A beautiful butterfly comes out of the cocoon! It has colorful wings. The butterfly drinks nectar from flowers. We don't touch its wings — they are very delicate.
t.sbeea47248b: Egg — caterpillar — cocoon — butterfly! Let's show it with our hands: a fist — egg, a wiggling finger — caterpillar, closed palms — cocoon, palms open — the butterfly flies away!
t.scac9b49c58: What does a butterfly come from?
t.s50359517ef: Well done! A caterpillar eats leaves.
t.sb4c5004d5e: Can we touch a butterfly's wings?
t.sa09c960a8f: Great job! The wings are delicate, so we don't touch them.
t.sc58788ac02: Beep-beep! Look at the ground: tiny black dots are marching in a line! And someone in the grass is hopping and chirping «chirp-chirp». Who are they?
t.sce65d20bdd: This is an ant. It is very small, but it can lift things much heavier than itself! Ants live in a big family in a nest under the ground.
t.s3b4518f6e6: This is a grasshopper. Its back legs are long and strong, and it jumps very high. In summer it chirps in the grass «chirp-chirp».
t.s12ea3d6b23: Find an ant trail in the yard. Put a bread crumb next to it and watch: where will the ants carry it? We don't step on ants, we only look!
t.s1916c10382: Who can lift things heavier than itself?
t.s2b6b238607: That's right! The ant is very strong.
t.sf77a33a854: Great job! In a nest under the ground.
t.sbecc86ebc0: Beep-beep! A little beetle in a red coat with black dots landed on a leaf. Insects have one more secret — how many legs do they have?
t.s80fa61d1b8: This is a ladybug. It is red with black dots. The ladybug is a gardener's friend — it eats tiny insects that harm plants.
t.sdc47edea6d: Count to six on your fingers!
t.s51ae0aca43: All insects have six legs! Bee, butterfly, ant, grasshopper, ladybug — count: one, two, three, four, five, six!
t.s79ed1a9583: This is a magnifying glass. When we look through it, a tiny insect looks big. Explorers use it to study legs and wings.
t.sfc3b1a82cb: Counting song: bee — buzz, one! Butterfly — flutter, two! Ant — march, three! Grasshopper — hop, four! Ladybug — crawl, five! And they all have legs — six!
t.s66fc95e8b6: How many legs does an insect have?
t.s6ff71b5f15: Which insect is red with black dots?
t.s7f71b8f9fa: What makes small things look big?
t.s8a1761f51a: Great job! A magnifying glass makes things look big.
t.sb50ac3353b: Beep-beep! Our body has magic helpers: they help us see the world, hear it, smell it and taste it. Who are they?
t.s4d8cee08f2: With our eyes we see colors, shapes and mom's smile! We take care of our eyes: we don't rub them and don't sit too close to a screen.
t.sa3ef762c33: With our ears we hear birds singing, music and our friend talking. Very loud noise hurts our ears.
t.sef23d7de5d: Like you're smelling a flower: mmm!
t.sae8c4fc318: With our nose we smell things: the sweet smell of flowers, the yummy smell of flatbread and plov. The nose also helps us breathe.
t.sa4ac3a632d: With our tongue we taste: honey is sweet, lemon is sour, salt is salty. Our tongue also helps us swallow food.
t.s25bb23862b: With a grown-up: close your eyes. Use your nose — is it an apple or a lemon? Use your ears — is it a clap or a knock? Which sense helped you?
t.s5348562a63: How do we smell a flower?
t.s08f4e229ae: That's right! We smell with our nose.
t.s2d716823a0: How do we know a lemon is sour?
t.sa316207215: How do we hear birds singing?
t.sd9f9b4f845: Great job! We hear with our ears.
t.s665411cef3: Beep-beep! Put your hand on your chest. Thump-thump… Someone inside you is working nonstop! Who is it?
t.s2c9fa4abcf: Walk, then jump — is your heart beating faster?
t.s499d6b38fd: Your heart is in your chest, and it's as big as your fist. Day and night it goes «thump-thump» and sends blood all around your body. When we run, it beats faster!
t.sdf90ba3b4f: Take a deep breath in — puff, and breathe out!
t.sb55ddc674d: We breathe air in through our nose, and it goes to the lungs in our chest. Then we breathe out. Walks in fresh air make our lungs strong.
t.sa5b9b2a43e: Skin covers our whole body. With our skin we feel: ice is cold, tea is hot, a cat is soft, a stone is hard. This is the fifth sense!
t.s86e65fad5a: Put your hand on your chest and listen to your heartbeat. Now jump in place 10 times! Listen again — is your heart beating faster? That's how our body answers to moving!
t.sc44f35f151: How does your heart beat when we run?
t.s04f0a81d0c: That's right! The heart beats faster.
t.s5112fc8fea: How do we feel that ice is cold?
t.s844b569936: Well done! We feel it with our skin.
t.s0865c2242e: Which body part takes in air?
t.sb32cfd2f32: Great job! The lungs take in air.
t.s2d891a24b6: Beep-beep! There are four magic habits that make you strong and healthy. Do you know them all? Let's check!
t.s560b31d9a0: Fruit, vegetables, milk, porridge and bread are healthy food that helps us grow. Sweets and chips we eat just a little, because they hurt our teeth.
t.s90a0e6ab5d: When we sleep, our body rests and grows. Kids need to go to bed early and sleep a long time. Before bed — no screens, a fairy tale instead!
t.sccc987168f: Every morning we do exercises: we stretch, jump and run. Our muscles get strong and we feel happy!
t.s6fa5722da4: You can't see germs, but they can make you sick. Before eating and after coming in from outside, we wash our hands with soap — counting to twenty!
t.s0193a78abc: Do it with me! Arms up — stretch! Bend to the side! Jump 5 times: one, two, three, four, five! Deep breath — puff! Now we're strong!
t.s363437c62a: When should kids go to bed?
t.s41951c0790: Well done! We go to bed early.
t.s545a6df2ba: Great job! We wash our hands.
t.s12075b4f61: Very good! The heart is in the chest.
t.sd00b6fea00: Beep-beep! There are heroes in the city! They help sick people get better, put out fires and keep order. Who are they? Let's meet them!
t.sdfce6fc812: When we are sick, the doctor checks us and helps us get well. The ambulance is called by dialing 103. Only grown-ups give medicine!
t.s1c22d525b1: Pretend you're spraying water from a hose!
t.s1595be895b: The firefighter comes in a red truck, puts out the fire with water and saves people. We call the firefighters by dialing 101.
t.s9e20018296: A police officer keeps order on the street and helps people. If you get lost, you can ask a police officer for help. Their number is 102.
t.s92c38aa500: Role-play game: I say a job, and you show what they do. Doctor — listen to the heart! Firefighter — spray the water! Police officer — show «stop» with your hand!
t.sd933430067: Who helps us get well when we're sick?
t.s637aa421a8: Who do we go to if we get lost?
t.s6beb83fd1f: Great job! To a police officer.
t.seff6963ceb: Beep-beep! Who grows our bread? Who builds houses? Who cooks food? Every job is important to people! Let's find out!
t.s859cf1aecf: The kindergarten teacher reads us fairy tales, plays games with us and teaches us new things. The teacher takes care of us.
t.sc2d9ce2dd9: A cook makes tasty and healthy food. Our kindergarten has a cook too — the cook makes us porridge and soup.
t.sef70f47c12: A farmer grows wheat, cotton and vegetables in the field. Wheat becomes flour, and flour becomes bread. We never waste bread!
t.sf3d8d8f399: A builder lays bricks and builds houses, kindergartens and schools. A builder wears a hard helmet — that keeps the head safe.
t.s5d77d6dd7a: The farmer sows wheat — the wheat ripens — at the mill it becomes flour — the baker bakes bread — the bread comes to our table! So many people worked for one flatbread!
t.sade1d06535: That's right! The farmer grows wheat.
t.s3dfbb43ccf: Well done! The builder builds a house.
t.s54ff862ae7: Who reads fairy tales in kindergarten?
t.s8ee601c0e8: Great job! The kindergarten teacher reads them.
t.s8e46e75686: Beep-beep! Transport is everything that carries people and things. Some travel on land, some on water, and some in the air! First, let's meet the ones on land.
t.s6474c50ada: Pretend you're buckling your seat belt: click!
t.s8c4aa83338: A car drives on the road, and a driver drives it. In the car, kids sit in a special car seat and wear a seat belt.
t.sd35412654d: A bus carries lots of passengers from stop to stop. On the bus we hold on to the handrail.
t.sec2ecb6145: A train runs only on rails. A train driver drives it. On a fast train we can quickly get from Samarkand to Tashkent!
t.s9149d9b830: We ride a bike by turning the pedals with our feet. On a bike we always wear a helmet and never ride onto a big road!
t.s7ff12784f6: That's right! A train runs on rails.
t.s7e641934a9: What do we wear on our head when we ride a bike?
t.s1246c1cb7c: Well done! We wear a helmet.
t.sade959b538: What do kids wear in the car?
t.s24af49cca2: Beep-beep! I fly, a fish swims. And people? They invented amazing machines to swim and fly too! Let's see!
t.s5cda985e01: A ship sails on the sea and carries lots of people and cargo. A captain steers the ship. The ship honks «toot-toot».
t.s80061a7839: The wind moves a sailboat! The wind blows into the sail, and the boat glides on the water.
t.sa24564db50: A plane flies across the sky very fast, and a pilot flies it. The plane takes off and lands at the airport.
t.sf5eef0de25: A helicopter has a spinning rotor on top. It can go straight up and stay in one spot in the air. Rescuers fly in helicopters.
t.s32379b6dc2: With a grown-up, pour water into a bowl. Drop in a piece of wood, a paper boat, a pebble and a plastic lid. Which ones float, and which ones sink? Think about why ships float!
t.s15e53187d6: Game time! If it goes on land — stomp your feet, if it sails on water — swim, if it flies in the air — flap your wings! Bus! Ship! Plane! Train! Helicopter!
t.sfe8e0002f7: That's right! A ship sails on water.
t.s4301ef45bc: Well done! The pilot flies it.
t.s8b21a3a92a: Great job! The wind moves it.
t.sd2ba868935: Very good! A bike goes on land.
t.s293e314471: Beep-beep! In winter the forest has little food and it's very cold. Some animals solve this in an amazing way — they sleep all winter long! Who are they?
t.s1497ff97d8: Yawn like a bear and go to sleep!
t.s70f656ecbf: In autumn the bear eats a lot and gets fat. Then it gets its den ready and sleeps all winter. In spring it wakes up hungry!
t.s978468b83c: A hedgehog has spines on its back. In winter it crawls into a pile of leaves, curls up into a ball and sleeps. We don't touch a hedgehog — its spines are prickly!
t.s5fae28c328: Hibernation is when an animal sleeps all winter without moving. Its heart beats slowly, and it lives on the fat it stored up in autumn.
t.s4299437ce8: Who sleeps in a den in winter?
t.s109287bfcf: That's right! The bear sleeps in winter.
t.saf3a8fdd5c: When does the bear wake up?
t.s75bc643958: Great job! It wakes up in spring.
t.sf0f523b3a1: Beep-beep! Some animals don't sleep in winter. So how do they keep from going hungry and hide from enemies? Let's learn two clever tricks!
t.s3712c4e041: A squirrel lives in a tree and has a fluffy tail. In autumn it gathers nuts and mushrooms and hides them in a tree hollow. In winter it eats these supplies.
t.s9e96c9bef0: A food supply is food gathered ahead of time, for later. Squirrels, mice and ants store up food for winter.
t.s2f112a9a7b: The snowshoe hare's fur is gray in summer and snow-white in winter! That way it can't be seen in the snow, and it hides from the wolf.
t.s0ddec7db43: Game: a grown-up hides 5 nuts or little balls around the room. You're a squirrel — find them all and gather them in your «tree hollow» (a basket)! How many did you find? Count them!
t.s3a833b5cc0: That's right! The squirrel stores up food.
t.s7bacd1af57: What color is the hare in winter?
t.s035b224630: Well done! In winter it's snow-white.
t.s90a550f2c6: Why does the hare turn white?
t.s95b3fa3c02: Great job! To hide in the snow.
t.s84a8c3774c: Beep-beep! Some birds fly away to warm lands in autumn. But I, the pigeon, the sparrow and my other friends stay here for the winter. How will you help us?
t.s7d0b53c5ea: Swans, storks and cranes fly away to warm lands in autumn, because in winter the lake freezes and there's no food. They come back in spring.
t.s75184e6372: In winter it's hard for birds to find food. We scatter grain, seeds and bread crumbs for them. That's a kind thing to do!
t.s2b33d065b5: With a grown-up, we make a bird feeder from a little box and hang it on a tree. Every day we put grain in it and watch the birds.
t.s14bef4ea65: Which birds come to the feeder? Sparrows or pigeons? Count them every day and draw them. So we don't scare the birds, we watch quietly from the window.
t.s73f5c9f8d6: Where does the swan fly in autumn?
t.s98f3e3a596: What do we give birds in winter?
t.sb369aadc89: What do we make for birds?
t.s3ba4dbc5c5: Great job! We make a bird feeder.
t.s887ff1acfc: Beep-beep! Water comes out of the tap. But where does the tap get its water? It's a long journey! Let's travel together with a little water drop!
t.seab775164f: A cloud is millions of tiny water drops floating in the air. When the drops get many and heavy, the cloud turns dark.
t.s755514bedc: Heavy drops fall from the cloud to the ground as rain. In the mountains they fall as snow. In spring the snow in the mountains melts.
t.se3640a754b: Rainwater and melted snow flow into streams, and streams flow into a river. The Zarafshan River flows past Samarkand!
t.s7a865cefb1: What is a cloud made of?
t.s69bb673b52: Where does the water go when the snow in the mountains melts?
t.sde32a5d59f: Beep-beep! Water is magic! It can be hard, it can flow, and it can even fly into the air where we can't see it! Let's see three kinds of magic!
t.s99fe8e3246: Plain water is a liquid: it flows and takes the shape of its container. We drink it, wash with it and water flowers.
t.s4b808b5225: When it's very cold, water freezes into hard ice. When it's warm, the ice melts and turns back into water. In winter a lake gets covered with ice too.
t.s291b83d6bf: If we heat water, it turns into steam and floats up. When the sun warms a lake or the sea, the water also turns into vapor and rises into the sky — up to the clouds!
t.s1f5ce7de04: The sun warms the water — it rises as vapor — becomes a cloud — falls as rain — flows into a river — and the sun warms it again! That's how water goes around and around.
t.s11df6076b1: Only with a grown-up: ask them to hold a cold mirror over hot tea. Little drops appear on the mirror — that's steam turning back into water! Just like in a cloud. We never touch hot steam!
t.s74265fcb00: What does water turn into when it's very cold?
t.s537ce267bb: That's right! In the cold it turns into ice.
t.sccded13612: What happens if we heat water?
t.sfa28c98dad: Well done! It turns into steam.
t.s28481eeec0: Where does the steam rise to?
t.s4001ec7e85: Great job! The vapor rises up to the clouds.
t.s6760539be6: Beep-beep! Clean drinking water is a very precious treasure. It travels a long way to our tap and gets cleaned on the way. How do we save it? There are three simple rules!
t.s9d04f1f72c: Twist your hand like you're closing a tap!
t.s4ddaf3d760: After washing our hands, we close the tap tightly. When we brush our teeth, we turn the water off too. One dripping tap wastes a whole bucket of water a day!
t.s2d2f4f5e3a: A quick shower uses less water than a full bath. When we're done washing, we turn the water off!
t.s9649af20b7: Is there water left in your glass? Don't pour it out — give it to a flower! You can also water flowers with the water you washed fruit in.
t.se32ad3b58d: From today, you are a water guardian! Is a tap dripping at home? Tell a grown-up. Every day you close the tap, draw yourself a little star!
t.s91c7f06654: What do we do with the tap when we brush our teeth?
t.s7842d5aa2f: That's right! We keep the tap closed.
t.s423cd36a1d: What do we do with the water left in the glass?
t.s2e618cf489: Well done! We water a flower.
t.s59240fa92a: Great job! A quick shower uses less water.
t.s25a1cb854d: Beep-beep! There's a friend on the street with three eyes. It doesn't talk, but its colors tell us what to do. Who is it?
t.s435e73349d: When the traffic light is red — we stop! We don't cross the road, even if there are no cars. Red is the danger color.
t.s30b6018929: When the light is yellow — we get ready and wait. Yellow says: «Attention! The color is about to change».
t.sfd140f0b44: When the light is green — we can cross the road. But first we look left, then right, and hold a grown-up's hand.
t.s854eba7b4d: Game time! I say a color: red — you freeze, yellow — you clap your hands, green — you march in place. Ready! Green… Yellow… Red! Who got it all right?
t.sffa4d67671: What do we do at a red light?
t.s7bb0519726: That's right! On red, we stop.
t.s14d5e4a65e: On what color do we cross the road?
t.s1871872a7e: Well done! We cross on green.
t.s0fc40c2c66: What does the yellow light say?
t.s7e91bd507a: Great job! Yellow means wait and get ready.
t.s4d64d39403: Beep-beep! There are black and white stripes on the road, just like a zebra's coat! They're there for a reason. What are they?
t.s648f2aaba9: The white stripes on the road are a pedestrian crossing — we call it a «zebra». We cross the road only here, walking, not running.
t.s6467f09a25: Reach out your hand to a grown-up!
t.s5698799d62: On the street and when crossing the road, we always hold a grown-up's hand tightly. We never go onto the road alone!
t.sc3c26a71d0: We don't play ball on the road or near cars. That's what the playground is for — it's safe there!
t.s31be7378ed: Where do we cross the road?
t.sd127a22c39: That's right! At the pedestrian crossing.
t.s6ad8af6530: Well done! We play on the playground.
t.s7bdce4ed0d: Who do we cross the road with?
t.s5cc4d3bed0: Great job! We cross with grown-ups.
t.s6f1045a8c9: Beep-beep! Fire keeps us warm and cooks our food. But if we play with it, a big fire can start! Let's learn the fire rules.
t.s5993a8564b: Fire is very hot and it burns. We don't touch matches, lighters or the stove — they are for grown-ups. Playing with fire is not allowed!
t.sa25d91eebd: This is a fire extinguisher. Grown-ups use it to put out a small fire. It is red, and you can see one at kindergarten and at school.
t.s034323c7c8: If we see smoke or fire — we don't hide! We quickly leave the house and shout for grown-ups. Grown-ups call 101, and the firefighters come.
t.s9640687219: Role-play: when you hear the signal «Smoke!» — bend down low and walk calmly to the door, and everyone gathers by the teacher. No running, no hiding. Well done, everyone is safe!
t.sc31c29f281: That's right! We don't play with fire.
t.s4f769ea089: What number do we call for a fire?
t.s06ee517627: What do we do if we see smoke?
t.sb6e47606ec: Great job! We get out and tell a grown-up.
t.s853894aaad: Beep-beep! People may all be nice, but some of them we don't know. How do we talk to someone we don't know? Let's learn some important rules.
t.s577e37b618: A stranger is a person we don't know. A stranger may look kind and offer you candy or a toy. But we never go anywhere with a stranger!
t.s430d3c6e46: If a stranger says «Come with me», we shout «No!» and run to our parents or our teacher.
t.s0519293fc0: If a stranger talked to us, we always tell our parents. We learn their full names and phone number by heart.
t.sde22be68e4: With a grown-up: repeat your mom's or dad's full name and phone number together. Say it once every day. If you get lost — you'll tell a police officer or a shop assistant!
t.s30446f28f7: Beep-beep! You learned about seasons, plants, insects, your body, jobs and transport, water and safety rules. You're a real little explorer! Let's clap!
t.s81c0f5c9e0: A stranger offers candy. Do we take it?
t.sd305b24d29: That's right! We don't take things from strangers.
t.s9f509fca59: What do we say if a stranger says «Come with me»?
t.s1e998bfa9c: Great job! We tell our parents.
t.s1511af8832: Very good! We don't play with fire.
t.se18e2c6886: Beep-beep! Hello, little explorer! I'm robot Kabu. Here's a question: how is a kitten different from a stone? Let's find out the secret together today!
t.s887e45a702: A living thing breathes, eats and grows. A kitten drinks milk, so it grows strong. Did you know cats sleep up to 15 hours a day?
t.s6ca0c380b7: A non-living thing doesn't breathe, eat or grow. Even if a stone lies there for a hundred years, it won't get bigger. A spoon, a table and a ball are non-living too.
t.s67e0a2c8c6: All living things grow. A little chick hatches from an egg, eats grain and becomes a big hen. You grow taller every year too!
t.s78865c30e0: Movement game! I'll say a word. If it's living — jump in place, if it's non-living — squat down. Puppy! Chair! Fish! Pencil! Bird! Well done!
t.sa00b9afb73: That's right! A puppy breathes, eats and grows — it's alive.
t.s4838248a63: Well done! A spoon doesn't breathe or grow — it's non-living.
t.s4b2fccf6dd: What happens when a chick eats grain and grows?
t.s71f2fca4c3: Great job! The chick grows into a big hen.
t.s2a60e8b954: That's right! A stone is non-living, it doesn't grow.
t.se0c8c2e64e: Beep-beep! A flower doesn't run or talk. So is it alive? Let me tell you a secret: a flower drinks water and grows too!
t.sf4c8002e47: A plant is alive too: it drinks water, reaches for the sun and grows. A sunflower always turns its flower toward the sun. In one summer it grows taller than you!
t.sf98191d734: A seed is a tiny sleeping plant. If we plant it in the soil and water it, it wakes up and starts to grow. One tiny apple seed grows into a big apple tree!
t.scc46a1ea1e: A sprout is a young plant that has just come out of a seed. First a little root grows down, then two green leaves come up. With water and sun, the sprout grows every day.
t.s95b331307a: An experiment with a grown-up! Put wet cotton wool in a glass and place 2–3 beans on top. Dampen the cotton a little every day. In 3–4 days the beans will sprout! Look every day and draw a picture.
t.se345465af8: That's right! A plant drinks water and grows — it's alive.
t.sf2606ebf72: What does an apple tree grow from?
t.s12b9b8f2a2: Well done! An apple tree grows from a tiny seed.
t.s661cf40f2c: What comes out of a seed first?
t.sf9c71e936b: Great job! First a little sprout comes out.
t.s9a9313d462: That's right! A plant drinks water through its roots.
t.s868821c4af: Beep-beep! In the morning I eat grain, drink water and take a deep breath. What about you? All living things need three important things. What are they?
t.sc2d56c9032: Food gives living things strength. We eat bread and fruit, a bunny eats carrots, a little bird pecks at grain. Nobody can grow without food.
t.s02b72435b7: There is no life without water: people, animals and plants all drink water. If a flower isn't watered, it wilts. More than half of our body is water!
t.s3b3c9b0cf2: Take a deep breath in and slowly breathe out!
t.s59bcaced2e: We breathe air. We can't see it, but we can't live even a minute without it. Hold your hand near your nose — your breath is warm air!
t.sfec431adfc: Let's sing together! «Food and water, fresh air too — living things all need them, it's true! Flowers, birds and me as well — every day I grow, hooray!» Clap your hands and once more!
t.s64787016b2: That's right! A bunny eats carrots — that's its food.
t.s98ea9798b7: What happens if a flower isn't watered?
t.s5224e09cfb: Well done! Without water a flower wilts.
t.see81792b23: What do we need to breathe?
t.s393deee2e7: That's right! All living things need water — people, animals and plants.
t.sfda3ab4b2e: Beep-beep! A doll has eyes and hands too. But is it alive like you? Let's check!
t.s000fac22d2: A person is a living thing too: we breathe, eat and grow. You were born a tiny baby, and now you're a big kid! People can also think and talk.
t.s1099a81447: Put your hand on your chest!
t.s8f7a1f48d6: Put your hand on your chest — thump-thump! That's your heart. It works day and night without stopping, because you are alive. When you run, your heart beats faster!
t.sb4ebc511b7: A doll and a teddy bear look like people, but they are non-living. They don't breathe, eat or grow. Even if you keep a teddy bear for a whole year, it stays just as small.
t.s716b993605: First sit quietly and put your hand on your chest: thump... thump... Now jump 10 times! Put your hand back: thump-thump-thump! Your heart sped up because your body needed more energy.
t.se1126147ca: That's right! A child breathes and grows.
t.sa23e337ed8: Well done! A doll is non-living, it doesn't grow.
t.sef117b45ec: How does your heart beat when you run?
t.s9ee7425c5a: Great job! When you run, your heart beats faster.
t.s18e11a0f21: That's right! Food, water and air — everyone needs them.
t.s6f0eb0fbb7: Beep-beep! Meet the water wizard. It can change its form: sometimes it flows, sometimes it freezes, sometimes it flies away! Today we'll discover its first secret.
t.sb66ad302c1: The water flowing from the tap is liquid. A liquid flows, and you can't hold it in your hand — it slips through your fingers. Milk and juice are liquids too.
t.s26b8eb308c: Water has no shape of its own. Pour it into a glass — it takes the glass's shape; pour it into a bowl — it takes the bowl's shape. Water always fits its container, just like magic!
t.sc4e6d3ece0: A drop is the tiniest bit of water. Rain is made of thousands of drops. A drop loves to be round!
t.saf25b57249: With a grown-up: pour a glass of water first into a tall jar, then into a wide bowl, then into a small bottle. Look, the water takes a new shape each time! There's still the same amount of water — only the shape changed.
t.s393bc033a9: That's right! Milk is a liquid — it flows.
t.s7e6236a0e2: What shape will water take if we pour it into a bowl?
t.sf458c481d4: Well done! Water takes the shape of its container.
t.s9793f71684: What happens if we try to hold liquid water in our hand?
t.sebd5c4f109: Great job! Liquid water runs out between your fingers.
t.s0dda907995: That's right! Rain is thousands of water drops.
t.sb1980c705e: Beep-beep! Where does the water in the stream go in winter? It doesn't disappear — the water wizard turns hard! Do you know what that is?
t.sf3887ac2c1: Ice is frozen water. When it's very cold, water stops flowing and turns into hard ice. Ice is hard like a stone, but very cold and slippery!
t.sbfa40f7171: When water turns into ice, we call it freezing. In winter, when it's very cold, puddles and ponds freeze. When water freezes, it gets a little bigger!
t.s8de1633e93: Inside the freezer it's as cold as winter. That's why water turns into ice there, and juice turns into an ice pop. Food in the freezer stays good for a long time.
t.s60db512557: With a grown-up: pour water into an ice cube tray and put a small leaf or flower petal in each cube. Put it in the freezer. Look the next day — the water froze into pretty ice with a leaf inside!
t.sea0131447a: That's right! Ice is frozen water.
t.s8696bca954: Well done! Water freezes when it's very cold.
t.s8c4d3e789b: Where do we put water to make ice?
t.s0f1b283def: Great job! It's very cold inside the freezer.
t.s31aaf173d0: That's right! Ice is hard and cold.
t.s443f36b44d: Beep-beep! I forgot the ice we made yesterday on the table. I looked — and there's only water on the saucer! Where did the ice go?
t.s24c5119cd2: In a warm place ice melts — it turns back into liquid water. The warmer it is, the faster ice melts. If you don't eat ice cream quickly, it melts and drips too!
t.s08f3b1b24c: Warmth melts ice. In spring the sun warms things up and the snow in the mountains melts. The melted snow flows down into streams and rivers.
