t.sf66ff4bf78: Snow is made of tiny bits of ice falling from the sky. Every snowflake has six points! If you hold snow in your hand, it quickly melts into water.
t.sa652ce049c: Take two ice cubes of the same size. Put one on a saucer in the shade and the other on a sunny windowsill. Which one melts faster? Guess! The one in the sun, of course — it's warmer there.
t.sd693200398: What happens to ice when it's warm?
t.se01491a9b2: That's right! In the warmth, ice melts into water.
t.s669811d54e: Well done! Snow is tiny bits of ice.
t.s6c1bf6b820: Why does the snow in the mountains melt in spring?
t.s6a99ed2d10: Great job! The sun warms it up and the snow melts.
t.sc0e2667816: That's right! When ice melts, it turns back into water.
t.s42ba5607f2: Beep-beep! The kettle goes «hiss-hiss», and something white like smoke comes out of the top. Is it smoke? No! It's the water wizard's third trick!
t.scfad7e92ee: Steam is water that has risen into the air. When water gets very hot, it flies up into the air in tiny, tiny bits. Steam is very hot, so we never touch it!
t.saa7be2080c: When water gets really hot, it boils: bubbles appear inside and it bubbles and gurgles. Lots of steam comes out of boiling water. Only grown-ups touch the kettle and the stove!
t.se0d2533d00: If we hang wet clothes on a line, they dry. That's because the water slowly turns into invisible vapor and flies off into the air. In the sun and the wind, clothes dry faster.
t.s795c379d36: Let's sing together: «When it's cold, I'm ice so still, when it's hot, I'm steam up high, flowing, flowing, on I go — I'm the magic water, hi!» When you hear «ice», freeze; when you hear «steam», raise your hands up high!
t.s54964e261c: What is the white stuff coming out of the kettle?
t.sd9174fa6b0: Can we touch steam with our hand?
t.s654e5f7c4f: Well done! Steam is very hot, it burns your hand.
t.s4b443004d5: Where do wet clothes dry faster?
t.s0c36981148: Great job! In the sun, water turns to vapor faster.
t.s32ea63353b: What are the three forms of water?
t.s2ec22dc34d: That's right! Water can be liquid, ice and steam.
t.s5fe3693319: Beep-beep! There's an invisible friend in this room. It's everywhere: all around you, inside a balloon, even in an empty glass. Who could it be?
t.s0468b8a324: Air has no color, no smell, and you can't see it, but it's everywhere. Wave your hand quickly and you'll feel air touch your face. Birds and planes fly in the air.
t.s201eaf7df3: When we blow up a balloon, it gets bigger — air went inside! If we let go of the end, the air rushes out with a «whoosh» and the balloon flies away. So air is real!
t.sfe626ffba8: We breathe air in through our nose — that's breathing. Then we breathe it out. Blow on your palm — can you feel the warm air?
t.sb0af79b782: Pour water into a glass and gently blow into it through a straw. Blub-blub-blub! Bubbles appeared in the water. That's the air from your breath! We only blow out, we don't suck the water in.
t.s6d22c74cb6: That's right! Air is invisible, but it's there.
t.s2140daa72f: Well done! The balloon is full of air.
t.s044e2e767b: What do we take in when we breathe?
t.s8e3c9856b0: Wind is running air. When air moves fast, trees sway and leaves fly. A strong wind can even blow a hat right off your head!
t.s52b0b738e2: A kite flies well on a windy day. The wind pushes the kite and lifts it into the sky. Without wind, the kite falls to the ground.
t.s107b8dacad: A sailboat has no engine. The wind blows into the big sail and pushes the boat forward. Long ago, people crossed the seas in boats like that!
t.s1999f48b62: You are the leaves! When I say «light wind», sway gently. When I say «strong wind», spin and run. When I say «the wind stopped», freeze! Ready? Light wind...
t.sef2e26bebb: That's right! Wind is moving air.
t.s27ca9a751e: When does a kite fly well?
t.sb228cb8159: Well done! The wind lifts the kite.
t.s54e5338a39: Great job! The wind pushes the sail.
t.s89b5618fb4: That's right! The balloon is full of air.
t.s6d80b76121: Beep-beep! I'll show you a magic experiment: we'll put paper into water, and it won't get wet! Don't believe me? Let's try it!
t.s7a484fbf41: An empty glass isn't really empty — it's full of air. If we turn the glass upside down and push it into water, the air won't let the water in. Air never gives its place away!
t.s75547d2262: The bubbles in water are air. Air is lighter than water, so bubbles always rise to the top. Fish breathe the air in the water too.
t.s7216947976: There's air inside a bike tyre too. When we pump air in, the tyre gets hard. When the air comes out, the tyre goes soft.
t.s2ba1bc73b0: With a grown-up: push a paper napkin tightly into the bottom of a glass. Turn the glass upside down and lower it straight down into a bowl of water. Then lift it straight up. The napkin is dry! The air in the glass kept the water out.
t.s54f597a720: That's right! An empty glass is full of air.
t.sbee0554017: Where do the bubbles in water go?
t.s00b73a010f: Well done! Air is light, so the bubbles rise up.
t.s9b225c7ae3: What do we pump into a bike tyre?
t.s91964f03f4: Great job! We pump in air with a pump.
t.s6646195421: What flies on a windy day?
t.sc162849ac9: That's right! The wind makes the kite fly.
t.s71534a255d: Beep-beep! In the park it's nice to breathe, but on a smoky street we start coughing. Why is that? It turns out air can be clean or dirty!
t.s6f7e7b4f69: Trees clean the air: their leaves catch dust and give us clean air to breathe. That's why the air in the park is so nice. One big tree makes enough clean air for several people!
t.s1a7441645d: Smoke comes from factory chimneys, from cars and from burning rubbish. Smoke makes the air dirty, and breathing it is harmful. That's why we don't burn rubbish!
t.s006f6a9c53: If the room is stuffy, we open the window to let air in. Fresh air comes in, old air goes out. If we air the room before bed, we sleep well.
t.sb944269310: Let's sing: «Little tree, little tree, with your leaves so green! You clean the air for me, the freshest air I've seen!» Spread your arms like branches and sway in the wind!
t.sb004468b98: That's right! Trees clean the air.
t.s59fd5647a8: Well done! Smoke makes the air dirty.
t.sad11fac3bf: What do we do to let fresh air into the room?
t.s6ad7739c36: Great job! We open the window and air the room.
t.s7fabd0cd5a: Beep-beep! Who wakes us up every morning and lights and warms the earth? It's very, very far away, but we all need it. You guessed it — the Sun!
t.sa7e42eb2df: The Sun is a huge star, hot like fire. It's very far from Earth, so it looks small. Really, the Sun is so big that a million Earths could fit inside it!
t.s4652e518ff: Sunlight gives us light and warmth. Without it, plants wouldn't grow and the Earth would be icy cold. Touch a stone that's been in the sun — it's warm.
t.scaee340add: Pretend to put on your sun hat!
t.sc30904cc51: Looking straight at the Sun hurts your eyes. On hot summer days we wear a hat and drink lots of water. Then the sun is only good for us.
t.s06b2a4b889: Pour water into two identical glasses. Put one in the sun and one in the shade. After an hour, touch them with your finger. Which one is warmer? The one in the sun! The sunlight warmed the water.
t.sfb4fbb4be3: That's right! The Sun is a huge hot star.
t.sc12fc696f0: What does the Sun give us?
t.sc1da3b0dbe: Well done! The Sun gives light and warmth.
t.s3013c31b6e: Is it okay to look straight at the Sun?
t.s5b87cbef30: Great job! We never look straight at the Sun.
t.s63a9ddfc8f: What do we wear in hot summer?
t.sa0c939c3c7: That's right! A hat protects us from the sun.
t.s6ba5505431: Beep-beep! At night a silver lamp shines in the sky. One day it's round, another day it's thin like a sickle. What kind of magic is this?
t.sb7040b1fa1: The Moon is a big ball of rock that goes around the Earth. The Moon doesn't shine by itself — it reflects the Sun's light like a mirror. That's why it looks bright at night.
t.s7f3ee13943: Every day the Moon looks a little different: sometimes round, sometimes half, sometimes a thin crescent. It depends on which side of the Moon faces the sunlight. In about a month, the Moon is full again.
t.s211e200046: An astronaut is a person who flies into space in a rocket. Astronauts went to the Moon and walked on it! There's no air on the Moon, so they wear special suits.
t.s66cb8d0857: For one week, every evening, look at the sky with a grown-up and draw the Moon in your notebook. Is it round, half, or a crescent? At the end of the week, compare your drawings — how did the Moon change?
t.seb68ef7c30: Does the Moon shine by itself?
t.s18b3d578ec: That's right! The Moon reflects the Sun's light.
t.s4b3ad09a91: What do we call a thin Moon shaped like a sickle?
t.s323758e366: Great job! Astronauts went to the Moon.
t.s2ac2d0623e: When can we see the Moon best?
t.s7dbcbeaf4f: That's right! The Moon is easy to see at night.
t.sc24bfe74a7: Beep-beep! At night thousands of tiny lights twinkle in the sky. Who lit them? Let's find out their secret!
t.s1afb5d327d: Stars are huge hot balls, just like our Sun. They're very, very far away, so they look like tiny dots. The Sun is a star too — it's just the closest one to us!
t.s4cc3b1609b: Stars are in the sky during the day too, but sunlight hides them. At night, when it's dark, we can see them. Far from city lights, you can see so many stars!
t.s2b0626d57f: A telescope is a tool that makes faraway things look close. Scientists watch the stars and the Moon through telescopes. Long ago in Samarkand, Ulugbek built a big observatory and studied the stars!
t.s2b1befc0d3: Let's sing together: «Twinkle, little star, like a bead up in the sky! You are very far, as big as the Sun up high!» Open and close your fingers and twinkle like a star!
t.s4eef63d154: That's right! A star is a very faraway sun.
t.sbb4b09af28: Which star is closest to us?
t.s5b5375741a: Well done! The Sun is our closest star.
t.s904f057968: A tool that makes faraway things look close?
t.s86b9f7d221: Great job! A telescope makes stars look close.
t.s67b4c8e60f: Why can't we see stars in the daytime?
t.s08bc8722a8: That's right! The bright Sun hides them.
t.s6da623202e: Beep-beep! The Sun comes up — we wake up. The Sun goes down — the Moon and stars appear in the sky. So much changes in one day!
t.s58216548a7: In the daytime the Sun is in the sky, and it's bright and warm. People work, and children go to kindergarten and play. Day starts in the morning.
t.s8e8bb137b0: When the Sun sets, night comes: it's dark, and the Moon and stars are in the sky. At night most people sleep. But some animals, like the owl, wake up at night and hunt!
t.s8f0448ccb0: Put your hands together like a pillow and close your eyes!
t.s8aedebba21: When we sleep at night, our body rests and grows. Children your age need 10–11 hours of sleep at night. A child who sleeps well is cheerful in the morning!
t.sad10c554e5: When I say «Day!», stand up and move like you're playing. When I say «Night!», crouch down, make a pillow with your hands and «sleep». I'll go faster and faster: Day! Night! Day! Night! Night!
t.sf602249df3: What is in the sky in the daytime?
t.s3c3ca5f9d8: That's right! In the daytime the Sun shines.
t.sa27b20b15c: What can we see in the sky at night?
t.s81cb99ca12: Well done! At night we see the Moon and stars.
t.s4cfb7b29b4: What do we do at night?
t.sc8eca023d6: Great job! At night we sleep and rest.
t.s5f6cf22d37: Who wakes up at night to hunt?
t.s90c43a3260: That's right! The owl hunts at night.
t.sd5b25db7d9: Beep-beep! Yesterday I saw a cow and a rabbit in a field. It turns out neither of them eats meat! So what do they eat to get full?
t.s4361bbe604: Plant-eating animals eat only plants: grass, leaves, fruit and grain. A cow chews grass all day long. And from that grass she gives us tasty milk!
t.s5019dba718: A rabbit is a plant-eater. It eats carrots, cabbage and grass. A rabbit's teeth grow its whole life, so it's always nibbling on something!
t.s811e78f5c5: The giraffe is the tallest animal in the world. With its long neck it eats leaves from tall trees. Its tongue is very long too, and it's bluish!
t.sc78f5b39b0: You're the cook! robot Kabu places an order: «Lunch for the rabbit!» — bring a carrot. «For the cow!» — grass. «For the giraffe!» — reach your hand up high and give it leaves. Well done, cook!
t.scc878eb707: Well done! The rabbit eats carrots and grass.
t.s5dbf767aa0: Great job! The giraffe eats leaves from tall trees.
t.s297c8bd0f3: The cow eats grass. What does she give us?
t.s359c77a43a: That's right! The cow gives milk.
t.s9e5f670efe: Beep-beep! In the forest there are animals that don't eat grass. They have sharp teeth and keen eyes. Who are they? Let's meet them carefully!
t.s7e7cb88f67: Predators hunt other animals and eat meat. They have sharp teeth and claws. The lion is the most famous predator — its roar can be heard 8 kilometres away!
t.sae93b6c6c1: The wolf is a predator, and wolves hunt in a pack. Wolves «talk» to each other by howling. They're very tough and can travel a long way in one night.
t.s89fdaaedff: The eagle is a bird of prey. It has very sharp eyes: high in the sky, it can see a tiny mouse on the ground! Then it dives down fast and grabs it with its sharp talons.
t.sa7ea239b66: One child is the wolf, the others are bunnies. The bunnies hop out of their «house» and play. When robot Kabu says «The wolf is coming!», everyone runs home. A bunny the wolf catches becomes the next wolf!
t.sa0740e97a0: That's right! Predators hunt other animals.
t.s3e7d258d32: Well done! The wolf is a predator.
t.s2f31b4a2a6: Great job! The eagle hunts from the sky.
t.sae0b7eb198: What kind of animal is a giraffe?
t.s65e0083c6a: That's right! The giraffe eats leaves — it's a plant-eater.
t.s01989aef0e: Beep-beep! Does a bear eat honey or fish? Both! Today we'll meet animals that eat everything.
t.sad367029ba: Animals that eat everything eat both plants and animals. A bear eats berries, honey and roots, and it also catches fish in the river. Getting ready for winter, it eats a lot and gets fat!
t.sd714d8e651: The hedgehog is a little animal that eats everything. At night it finds and eats beetles, worms and slugs, and sometimes tastes fruit too. If it senses danger, it rolls into a prickly ball!
t.s71f7d10ad6: The sparrow eats everything too: it eats grain and seeds, and feeds its chicks insects. The sparrow eats harmful caterpillars in the garden and protects the trees.
t.sa158a3b1ea: Let's sing: «One — the bunny eats a carrot, two — the lion eats meat, three — the bear eats honey and fish, he eats everything he can eat!» Show the number on your fingers each time!
t.s6a95ea66a5: What do animals that eat everything eat?
t.s101558e1b0: That's right! They eat all kinds of food.
t.s97154974aa: Well done! The bear eats honey and fish too.
t.se34f34ccb5: What does a hedgehog do when it senses danger?
t.s4b445a9d30: Great job! It rolls into a prickly ball.
t.s569a6734d9: What kind of animal is an eagle?
t.se1d5efbfec: That's right! The eagle is a bird of prey.
t.scc11e33fd1: Beep-beep! Grass is food for a grasshopper. And the grasshopper... is food for a frog! Look, they're linked like a chain. Let's build this chain together!
t.saaa647393b: A food chain is a line that shows who eats whom. For example: grass → grasshopper → frog → stork. Each link is food for the next one.
t.sdaedfa1bc6: Every food chain starts with a plant. A plant makes its food from sunlight. Without plants, both plant-eaters and predators would have no food!
t.s5a6d6637cf: A frog catches grasshoppers and flies with its long, sticky tongue. And the frog itself is food for a stork or a snake. So the frog is in the middle of the chain.
t.s60f3c292b7: Let four children hold hands and stand in a line: the first is grass, the second is a grasshopper, the third is a frog, the fourth is a stork. Each one introduces themselves: «I'm grass, the grasshopper eats me!» and so on.
t.s949c227c9f: What does a food chain start with?
t.sa5a5e2b817: That's right! The chain always starts with a plant.
t.s25bf31bd26: Grass → grasshopper → ? Who eats the grasshopper?
t.sb70d799378: Well done! The frog eats the grasshopper.
t.sc60cbd1c8f: What does a frog catch a fly with?
t.s0ff788de34: Great job! With its long, sticky tongue.
t.s62e21a198d: What happens if there are no plants?
t.sffdcd431b7: That's right! Everyone would go hungry — let's take care of plants.
t.s237611981c: Beep-beep! There's a place with lots of sand, little water, and very hot days. Do animals live in a place like that? Yes, they do — and they're very clever!
t.s0a7e0c63c2: A desert is a sandy, hot place with little water. It rarely rains there. Uzbekistan has a big desert too — it's called the Kyzylkum!
t.sab6f3b20d0: A camel can walk in the desert for a long time without water. Its hump stores fat, which gives it energy when there's no food. And when a camel drinks, it drinks a huge amount of water at once!
t.s6125143821: A lizard runs fast across the hot sand. In the morning it warms up in the sun, and in the midday heat it hides under the sand or beneath rocks. That's how it stays safe from the heat.
t.s7427e2ddc6: That's right! A desert has lots of sand and little water.
t.s45ff861738: Which animal can go a long time without water in the desert?
t.s06d9a96124: Well done! The camel is the ship of the desert.
t.s42706360b3: What does a lizard do in the hot midday sun?
t.s9df08b5bb7: Great job! It hides under the sand or a rock.
t.s8bd3cd2eb0: What's the name of the big desert in Uzbekistan?
t.sb3bed165f8: Beep-beep! I can fly high, high up, but climbing to a mountain top is hard! Some animals jump around steep cliffs without any fear. Who are they?
t.s2ed61c5303: A mountain is very high land. The higher the mountain, the colder it is at the top, so there's snow on the peaks even in summer. Mountain snow melts and fills the rivers with water.
t.sa8bd34197d: The mountain goat jumps on steep rocks without fear. Its hooves have soft pads, so it doesn't slip on the stones. Its horns are big and curved.
t.se782e5e8d6: The yak lives high in cold mountains. Its fur is very long and thick, just like a warm coat. People get milk and wool from yaks.
t.s0c54adb893: Put pillows on the floor — they are rocks! You are a mountain goat: carefully jump from pillow to pillow, don't touch the floor. Robot Kabu: «Baa-a-a! We reached the top!»
t.s6c8b800379: What stays on the mountain top even in summer?
t.sd5804f1d88: That's right! It's cold high in the mountains, so the snow doesn't melt.
t.sb7eaabfc38: Which animal jumps nimbly on the rocks?
t.s5ecae6b9c1: Well done! The mountain goat doesn't slip on the rocks.
t.s00dd53f335: What keeps the yak safe from the cold?
t.s0c46f29494: Great job! Its thick fur keeps it warm.
t.s66a10f3deb: Who is called the ship of the desert?
t.sd439540f00: That's right! The camel is the ship of the desert.
t.sb304eec95d: Beep-beep! There are so many trees in the forest that it's cool and mysterious inside. Someone is hiding nuts there, and someone calls «hoo-hoo» at night. Let's listen!
t.s17042ed5a3: A forest is a place where trees grow close together. It gives many animals a home and food. The forest cleans the air, so it is called «the lungs of the Earth».
t.s95379aa216: The squirrel lives in a tree hollow and jumps from branch to branch. In autumn it gathers nuts for winter and hides them in different places. It forgets some of them — and new trees grow from them!
t.sf962c7bc32: The owl sleeps during the day and hunts at night. Its big eyes see well in the dark. An owl can turn its head almost all the way back!
t.sda73c249ab: I say an animal, and you show how it moves. Squirrel — nibble a nut! Owl — open your eyes wide: «hoo-hoo»! Wolf — howl «ooo»! Bear — walk slowly and heavily!
t.s6bd67a0615: That's right! In the forest, trees grow close together.
t.s68a8136227: Which animal gathers nuts for winter?
t.s28ac5daf97: Well done! The squirrel hides nuts.
t.s6a4eecb7d4: Great job! The owl is a night bird.
t.s09919c5c59: Which animal lives in the mountains?
t.s45a723e97b: That's right! The mountain goat lives on the rocks.
t.sc344b3cc6a: Beep-beep! The sea is so big that you can't see its end. And at the bottom there is an amazing world! Let's put on our goggles and dive under the water!
t.sf67d6e73a0: The dolphin is a very smart and friendly sea animal. It is not a fish: it comes up to the surface to breathe air. Dolphins «talk» to each other with whistle-like sounds!
t.sfdc364be53: The blue whale is the biggest animal in the world — it is several times longer than a bus! The whale also breathes air and shoots a fountain of water from a hole on its head.
t.s8f53b0d3d6: The octopus has eight legs with suckers on them. When it senses danger, it lets out black ink and escapes. It can change its colour and hide by looking like a stone!
t.seda32950b5: Four corners: desert 🏜️, mountains 🏔️, forest 🌲, sea 🌊. I say an animal, and you run to its home! Camel! Dolphin! Squirrel! Mountain goat! Whale! Owl! Lizard!
t.s17169100a7: The biggest animal in the world?
t.sc932d6eb00: That's right! The blue whale is the biggest animal.
t.sc789a93138: What does a dolphin do to breathe?
t.s2f6c25f0b8: Well done! The dolphin breathes air.
t.scba07ff3f5: How many legs does an octopus have?
t.sa5ed225b67: Great job! It has eight legs.
t.sa0670c9a36: Which animal lives in the desert?
t.s0c2ff35d78: That's right! The camel is a desert animal.
t.s32b7dac5b0: Beep-beep! I was flying around the park and saw a plastic bottle on the grass. But birds and hedgehogs walk there! Where should this bottle have been?
t.sf3884b3ab1: We throw rubbish only into a bin. If there is no bin nearby, we put the rubbish in a pocket or bag and carry it until we find one. Then the streets stay clean.
t.sb4eacfedfc: Living in a clean place is nice and good for your health. Flies and germs multiply in dirty places. If we sweep the yard and the classroom together, everyone is happy!
t.s9261262cf6: A plastic bottle left in nature doesn't disappear for hundreds of years! Animals can swallow it or get stuck in it. That's why we never throw plastic in nature.
t.s152410c910: Let's sing: «Broom in hand, we go outside, sweep the yard both far and wide! Rubbish in the bin, flowers in the ground, keep our Earth clean all around!» Move like you are sweeping!
t.sf9199a3aad: That's right! Only into the bin.
t.s4fab9a1d2d: What do we do if there is no bin nearby?
t.s26a726c08f: Well done! We carry it until we find a bin.
t.s2fe1f4c53e: How long does a plastic bottle stay in nature?
t.s5ec8480ee4: Great job! Plastic takes a very long time to disappear.
t.se0de9fb209: What multiplies in a dirty place?
t.s2a4fdbc2a6: That's right! That's why we keep things clean.
t.s12c7930ae9: Beep-beep! Look, there are three coloured bins here. Why not just one? Because every kind of rubbish has its own home! Let's learn to sort.
t.sa3d85a6a88: Old newspapers, cardboard boxes and notebooks are paper rubbish. If we collect them separately, a factory makes new paper from them. Then fewer trees are cut down, because paper is made from wood!
t.s2a63702dcb: Plastic containers, bags and cups go into a separate bin. A factory makes new things from them. Even thread for clothes is made from plastic bottles!
t.s52d10f71c1: Glass jars and dishes are collected separately too. Glass can be melted to make new dishes again and again. We never touch broken glass — we call a grown-up!
t.se70a783319: Mark three bins: blue — paper, yellow — plastic, green — glass. Grown-ups will give you clean, safe rubbish: cardboard, a plastic bottle, an empty can. Put each one into the right bin!
t.se83deb612e: What kind of rubbish is an old newspaper?
t.s17c99c3b3f: That's right! A newspaper is paper.
t.s1a1853aca3: Where do we throw a plastic cup?
t.s706f06578b: Well done! Plastic goes into the plastic bin.
t.s727c80bbc2: If we collect paper, what do we save?
t.s4a844f3764: Great job! Paper is made from wood — we save the trees.
t.s3aff4d09fb: What do we do if we see broken glass?
t.s1b40c57387: That's right! We don't touch broken glass.
t.s62a3fc6625: Beep-beep! There's a magic word: rubbish can become something useful again! Old glass turns into new dishes, and a banana peel... into fertiliser! How does that work?
t.s7ed5df74e9: Recycling means a factory makes new things from old paper, plastic and glass. If you see this sign ♻️, the thing can be recycled. There is less rubbish, and nature stays clean!
t.s89186b74b7: Fruit peels and vegetable scraps rot in the soil and turn into fertiliser — this is compost. Compost is food for plants. Worms help us with this!
t.sd3cda16ef3: Some things don't have to be thrown away — we can use them again. We make a pencil holder from an empty can, a little house from a cardboard box, and a bag from an old T-shirt. This also takes care of nature!
t.sc1ee1083c3: With a grown-up: take a clean empty can (its edges must be smooth). Wrap it in coloured paper or yarn and stick on a star. Here's a new pencil holder! You turned rubbish into something useful.
t.s374bb3eb33: That's right! It means the thing can be recycled.
t.s7a06c43574: What does a banana peel turn into?
t.s0f2a099a0a: Well done! It rots and turns into fertiliser.
t.s7599b872e2: What can we make from an empty can?
t.s8a60fdc78b: Where do we throw paper rubbish?
t.sb2d6013d8a: That's right! Paper goes into the paper bin.
t.s1fd53e7d93: Beep-beep! Do you want to be a friend of nature? A friend of nature has three golden rules. Let's learn them!
t.sfdd69619cd: A seedling is a young little tree. If we plant it and water it, in a few years it becomes a big tree. Every tree cleans the air and gives birds a home.
t.s88b35ae8de: In winter, when snow covers everything, birds can't find food. If we hang a feeder and put grain or bread crumbs in it, the birds won't go hungry. And in spring they eat harmful bugs and protect the garden!
t.s9769c997e8: When wildflowers grow in their own place, they make everyone happy. A picked flower wilts quickly. We don't pick flowers — we smell them, draw them and enjoy them.
t.se850b8596e: Put your hand on your heart and promise with me: «I throw rubbish into the bin! I take care of water and flowers! I am kind to animals!» Well done, now you are a real friend of nature!
t.sdcd945faf7: What happens if we plant and water a seedling?
t.sf7c3f0c4c0: That's right! The seedling becomes a big tree.
t.sf91d23e57d: How do we help birds in winter?
t.se12a6710ce: Well done! We put out grain and bread crumbs.
t.s05aa43ca5e: What do we do when we see a wildflower?
t.sa8ed894af3: Great job! We don't pick flowers.
t.sda9b66c48f: What does fruit peel turn into?
t.sd8b67f755a: That's right! The peel turns into compost.
t.sc01315d499: Beep-beep! My nest is on a plane tree branch. Where is your home? Which neighbourhood do you live in? Let's learn our address!
t.s414eb69bad: A mahalla is a neighbourhood: houses close to each other and the people who live in them. In the mahalla we celebrate weddings and holidays together and help each other at hashar work days. Every mahalla has its own name.
t.s0db676929f: An address tells where your home is: the city, the street name and the house number. If you learn it by heart and get lost, you can tell a grown-up and get back home. Now say your address together with a grown-up!
t.sb0582efb61: Neighbours are the people who live next to us. We say hello to them and help when needed. Our people have a saying: «Don't choose a house — choose a neighbour»!
t.sc7e98fabdb: Role play. Kabu: «Hello, neighbour! How are you?» You: «Hello! I'm fine, thank you!» Kabu: «Our houses are side by side — shall we play together?» You: «Of course!» Now swap roles!
t.s50951bc3dd: That's right! A mahalla is a community of neighbours.
t.sdf05080c04: What should we say if we get lost?
t.sbab8b67df0: Well done! Knowing your address is very important.
t.sd898dc859b: What do we do when we see a neighbour?
t.s07ca81b848: Great job! We say hello to our neighbour.
t.se60987cee1: That's right! The street name and the house number.
t.sdfe2b9b668: Beep-beep! Mum went to get flatbread and apples. Where is she going? Today I'll take you shopping!
t.sf9791f489d: In a shop we buy things like bread, milk and toys. Before we take something, we pay money. When we leave the shop, we say «thank you» to the shop assistant!
t.s98c7b7722a: At the bazaar, farmers sell fruit and vegetables they grew in their own gardens. An Uzbek bazaar is very colourful: melons, watermelons, grapes, flatbread! The Siab Bazaar in Samarkand is very famous.
t.sb9c0dc22cf: The shop assistant arranges things in the shop and sells them to customers. They tell you how much to pay. We talk politely to the shop assistant.
t.s9123a747df: Build a shop from toys: an apple, flatbread, milk. One child is the shop assistant, the other is the customer. Customer: «Hello! One flatbread, please.» Shop assistant: «Here you are! That's two coins.» The customer pays and says «Thank you!»
t.s64a0b5246f: Where do we buy bread and milk?
t.s71abc549fe: That's right! We buy them in a shop.
t.s346430308f: Where are there lots of melons and watermelons?
t.sc32b1d1e3b: Well done! There is lots of fruit at the bazaar.
t.s749073590a: Who sells things in a shop?
t.s1fa1fc9993: That's right! Neighbours live next to us.
t.s27f1761f4a: In a hospital, sick people get treated. Doctors and nurses work there. If urgent help is needed, grown-ups call 103.
t.sf9fd722bd1: A doctor checks us and makes us better. With a special tool — a stethoscope — the doctor listens to our heart and lungs. We aren't afraid of doctors, they help us!
t.s7f4080c61d: At school, children learn to read, write and count. At your age you go to kindergarten, and then you'll go to school, to grade 1. At school teachers give lessons, and you'll make new friends!
t.s1212be7a3f: One child is the doctor, the other owns a sick teddy bear. Doctor: «Let's see! What's wrong?» Patient: «My teddy has a sore throat.» The doctor listens with a stethoscope: «Drink warm tea and rest!» Everyone: «Thank you, doctor!»
t.sca7be38c89: Where do we go if we are sick?
t.s5259dcf867: That's right! Doctors treat people in a hospital.
t.s0d9aec5cdd: What tool does a doctor use to listen to the heart?
t.s8c1e575ccd: Where do children learn to read?
t.s540f5d7c14: Beep-beep! There are many more wonderful places in our city. A beautiful building with a tall minaret, a park where children play, and a pole with coloured lights... Let's go for a walk!
t.s4b5f0d4695: A mosque is a place where people pray. A mosque has a beautiful dome and a tall minaret. The Bibi-Khanym Mosque in Samarkand is very old and famous!
t.s8724199e7c: A park has trees, flowers, fountains and rides. Here we walk and relax with our family. In the park we don't drop litter and don't pick flowers.
t.scdaa73c021: When I say red — stop, when I say green — march on the spot!
t.s7a3a4592a9: A traffic light has three lights: red — stop, yellow — get ready, green — go. We cross the street only on green, at the «zebra» crossing, holding a grown-up's hand!
t.s20c9ebeb4a: Let's sing: «Red light — we stop and stay, yellow — get ready, wait the way, green is on — off we go, hold hands and cross nice and slow!» Freeze on red, clap on yellow, march on the spot on green!
t.s75e27f4a59: What kind of place is a mosque?
t.sb550d7ae3f: That's right! People pray in a mosque.
t.s21822dcfa9: What does the red traffic light mean?
t.sae349154a4: On which light do we cross the street?
t.sbf4835d1c0: Great job! On green, together with a grown-up.
t.s170ba064c5: What must we not do in the park?
t.s3d9cac0140: That's right! We don't drop litter in the park and keep it clean.
t.se0d59a5151: Beep-beep! Hello, young scientist! Yesterday there was a big puddle in the yard, and today it's gone. Nobody swept it away. Where did the water go? This is the start of a big journey!
t.s7322726776: When the sun warms water, it breaks into tiny bits and rises into the air — this is evaporation. Water evaporates from the sea, rivers, puddles and even wet clothes. Every day lots and lots of water rises from the seas into the sky!
t.s08e4b3b38b: Water vapour can't be seen — it mixes with the air. The little white cloud from a kettle is vapour that cooled down and turned into tiny droplets. There is always a little invisible water vapour in the air.
t.s4945c5f22e: After rain, puddles are left on the road. When the sun comes out, they slowly get smaller and disappear. The water isn't gone — it evaporated and rose into the air!
t.se448e5b39a: Pour a spoonful of water into each of two saucers. Put one on a sunny windowsill and the other in a dark cupboard. Check in the evening. The one in the sun dried faster, because water evaporates quickly when it's warm!
t.s7f19d2cce2: Where does the water in a puddle go?
t.s9007be618c: That's right! The sun warms it, and the water evaporates.
t.scd075061e3: Well done! Heat makes water evaporate.
t.s4115ed489c: Great job! Water vapour is invisible.
t.s59e9d20d65: Where does the most water evaporate from?
t.sc4f80a526b: That's right! The sea is very big, so lots of water evaporates from it.
t.s75c28a415e: Beep-beep! When I fly up high, the air gets colder. The rising vapour gets cold too. What happens next? Snow-white «cotton wool» appears in the sky!
t.s7b3e0946f9: High up in the sky the air is cold. The rising vapour cools down and turns back into tiny water droplets. That's also how droplets appear on a cold glass!
t.s61b10c43e4: A cloud is millions of tiny water droplets and bits of ice floating in the air. They are so small that the air holds them up. A white cloud is light, but a dark cloud is full of water — it brings rain!
t.s1dbeededca: Fog is a cloud that forms close to the ground. On a cool morning the air gets colder, and the steam turns into tiny droplets. In fog you can't see far, so cars drive slowly.
t.s6480b6df5c: With a grown-up: pour a little warm water into a glass jar. Put a saucer on top and place some ice cubes on it. Wait a bit: fog appears inside the jar, and drops gather under the saucer. That's a little cloud!
t.s1ccb310840: Right! A cloud is millions of tiny droplets.
t.s6f0f309888: Why does steam turn into drops up high?
t.scd64b91e71: Well done! In the cold, steam turns into drops.
t.sd276490541: Great job! Fog is a cloud on the ground.
t.s766707826f: Right! A dark cloud is full of water.
t.sfad04720e2: Beep-beep! Dark clouds fill the sky, and thunder rumbles. What happens next? Rain, of course! But why is it raining right now? Let's find out.
t.s6681cd1a3e: Tiny droplets in a cloud join together and grow bigger. When a drop gets heavy, the air can't hold it anymore, and it falls to the ground — that's rain. A raindrop is a million times bigger than a tiny cloud droplet!
t.sc2c8a45903: In winter it is very cold inside a cloud. Instead of water drops, pretty ice stars form and fall as snow. Every snowflake has six points, but no two are the same!
t.sad73bed1fb: In a thunderstorm, bright lightning flashes from the clouds, and then we hear «boom-boom». We see the lightning first, because light travels faster than sound. In a storm we don't stand under a tall tree — we go inside!
t.sa29b991220: Let's sing: «Little drop, little drop, where do you go? — The Sun called me up to the sky, you know! I became a cloud, I grew heavy and round, then came back as rain to the ground!» Raise your hands up high and be steam, then wiggle your fingers down and make it rain!
t.s866cf93374: Right! The air can't hold heavy drops.
t.sb49f762ba9: What falls from a cloud in winter?
t.s8d16939b81: Well done! In the cold, drops freeze and turn into snow.
t.s41e44e4d64: How many points does a snowflake have?
t.s16c721976a: Great job! It has six points.
t.s887a15c22e: Where do we stay during a thunderstorm?
t.sb7be627122: Beep-beep! Here's a secret: the water you drank today was once in the sea, in a cloud and in the snow on a mountain! Water is always going around and around. Let's draw its whole journey!
t.s2c5a9bb009: The water cycle has four steps: water turns into steam, a cloud forms, rain falls, and the water goes back to rivers and the sea. This cycle never stops. Water on Earth has been going around like this for millions of years!
t.s4d449a5c54: Snow on the mountains melts and flows into streams together with rainwater. Streams join and become a big river. The biggest rivers in Uzbekistan are the Amu Darya and the Syr Darya.
t.s472cdbff17: Rivers carry water to the sea or a big lake. There the Sun warms the water again, and the cycle starts all over. That's how one little drop of water travels thousands of times!
t.s620f712b21: On paper, draw a blue sea at the bottom, a yellow Sun at the top, a cloud in the sky, and a mountain and a river on one side. Then use arrows to show the drop's path: sea → steam → cloud → rain → river → sea. The circle is closed!
t.s91307f5fd9: How does the water cycle start?
t.sbab0737b11: Right! The Sun turns water into steam.
t.sfdb3a3efc2: Well done! Rain falls from the cloud.
t.s68a7616b48: Great job! The Amu Darya and the Syr Darya.
t.sd43e6f444b: When does the water cycle stop?
t.s2585e13686: Right! Water keeps going around all the time.
t.s1908ff9e52: Beep-beep! The home we live in is very big — so big that we can't even tell it's round! It flies through space around the Sun. What is this home?
t.s13e3eae89e: Earth is the planet we live on. It isn't flat — it's round like a ball. From space, Earth looks blue, because most of it is ocean water!
t.sfcd2571715: A planet is a big ball that goes around a star. Eight planets go around the Sun, and Earth is the third one from the Sun. We know for sure that only Earth has water, air and living things.
t.s59da27873d: Earth flies around the Sun in a big circle. It takes one year to go all the way around once. Even right now, you are zooming along with Earth very fast!
t.sdd7d823928: One child is the Sun and stands in the middle. Another child is Earth and slowly walks around the Sun. After one full circle, we clap and say: «A year has passed!» Now swap roles!
t.s3ec66e0c3d: Right! Earth is round like a ball.
t.s135db10395: What color does Earth look from space?
t.s7f0678b940: Well done! Blue — thanks to the oceans.
t.s2b0aac3269: Great job! Earth goes around the Sun.
t.s586e2b3518: How long does it take Earth to go around the Sun?
t.s6e194bebf4: Beep-beep! The Sun comes up in the morning and goes down in the evening. It looks like it walks across the sky. But really, it's not the Sun that moves — it's our Earth! How can that be?
t.s039466bc3c: Earth spins around its axis like a spinning top. One full turn takes one day — 24 hours. We don't feel it, because everything around us spins along with us.
t.s7190708746: On the side of Earth facing the Sun, it's daytime — bright and warm. As Earth turns, the Sun seems to move across the sky. But really, we are the ones turning toward the Sun!
t.s73e582fed5: On the side of Earth turned away from the Sun, it's night. When we go to sleep, children on the other side of Earth are just waking up! That's how day and night take turns.
t.sc663b78fd8: Make the room dark. A grown-up turns on a flashlight — that's the Sun. Put a sticker on a ball — that's your home. Slowly turn the ball: sticker in the light — day, in the shadow — night!
t.s9ceb670091: Why do day and night change?
t.sce208da472: Right! Earth spins and turns toward the Sun, then away from it.
t.s65b216031d: How long does Earth take to spin around its axis once?
t.s4a80cddfb8: What is it like on the side of Earth facing the Sun?
t.se3d3eb17bf: Beep-beep! In one year nature changes its clothes four times: sometimes a flowery dress, sometimes a green one, sometimes a golden one, and sometimes a snow-white fur coat. Which seasons are they?
t.s9a6aacbe99: In spring the days get warmer, snow melts, and trees bloom. Birds come back from warm lands and build nests. Spring arrives with the Navruz holiday!
t.s869eb20328: Summer is the hottest season: the days are long, the nights are short. Apricots, cherries, melons and watermelons ripen in the gardens. In summer in Uzbekistan it can get as hot as 40 degrees!
t.s92b027f2a7: In autumn the air gets cool, and leaves turn yellow and fall. People pick cotton in the fields, and grapes and pomegranates in the gardens. Birds fly away to warm lands.
t.s67d40c6882: Winter is the coldest season: the days are short, the nights are long. Snow falls, and little streams freeze. Animals like bears and hedgehogs sleep until spring!
t.s5fed9cd480: Let's sing: «Spring is here — the flowers grow, summer's here — the melons glow, autumn's here — the leaves fall down, winter's here — snow all around!» Do a move for each season: smell a flower, eat a melon, spin like a leaf, play in the snow!
t.s4ca446e2fd: In which season do trees bloom?
t.s96bb060bdb: Right! In spring nature wakes up.
t.s4250938186: Well done! Summer is the hottest season.
t.s801ab65953: When do leaves turn yellow and fall?
t.sacb809b2cf: Which animal sleeps through the winter?
t.s28f33522de: Right! The bear sleeps until spring.
t.se2e558b9a2: Beep-beep! In summer the Sun is burning hot, but in winter the very same Sun hardly warms us. Why? Earth has a funny secret — it «leans»!
t.s904bdc6325: Earth goes around the Sun in one year. During that year the four seasons come one after another: spring, summer, autumn, winter. A year has 12 months, so each season gets 3 months.
t.s48b61e77c8: Earth doesn't spin straight up — it leans a little. So for part of the year our side leans toward the Sun — that's summer. For another part it leans away from the Sun — that's winter.
t.se8e3f17dfb: In summer the Sun's rays shine down more straight and warm the ground a lot. In winter the rays come in at a slant, spread out over the ground and warm it only a little. That's why summer is hot and winter is cold!
t.sa5db4d4927: In a dark room, shine a flashlight straight down onto paper — the spot is small and bright. Now tilt it — the spot is big but dim. A straight beam is summer: it warms a lot. A slanted beam is winter: the light spreads out.
t.sff28abdf35: Right! Earth goes around the Sun while leaning.
t.s6a43873d92: How many seasons are in a year?
t.s6d5741aa33: When do the Sun's rays shine down more straight?
t.sa42d66b2cf: Great job! In summer the rays shine straight down and warm a lot.
t.s02d0895f7f: Right! Spinning around its axis gives us day and night.
t.sf497e9a568: Beep-beep! A plant is like a team: each part has its own job. Who drinks water, who makes food, and who gives seeds? Let's meet them!
t.s30d19becbe: The root is under the ground. It soaks up water and good nutrients from the soil and holds the plant tight. A carrot is a sweet root that we eat!
t.s4e23a12d08: The stem is the plant's «road». It carries water from the root up to the leaves and flowers. A tree's stem is its thick trunk.
t.s3452d4659b: The leaf is the plant's kitchen. It makes food for the plant from sunlight, air and water. At the same time, it gives off fresh air for us to breathe!
t.s8d3f2066fb: A flower doesn't just make a plant pretty — it also gives seeds and fruit. Later, fruit grows where the flower was. Where an apple tree has white and pink flowers, apples ripen!
t.se47fedfd36: Stand up tall — you're a plant! Your feet are roots: press them firmly into the ground. Your body is the stem: stand straight. Your arms are leaves: spread them out wide. Your head is a flower: smile and look at the Sun!
t.s816ae3f187: What soaks up water from the soil?
t.sac51e9ef5b: Right! The root soaks up water.
t.s336520f276: Well done! The leaf makes food.
t.s43858107d6: What carries water to the leaves?
t.s57adcf429e: Great job! The stem is the water's road.
t.sd3cf82c6cc: What grows later where the flower was?
t.s8d4849a49e: Right! Fruit ripens where the flower was.
t.sfc591fdfb2: Beep-beep! A flower doesn't drink water with a mouth. So how does it drink? Today we'll do a magic experiment with colored water and see it with our own eyes!
t.s82a3a600ea: A plant soaks up water through its root and carries it up to the leaves through thin little tubes in the stem. If we put a celery stalk in colored water, a day later its leaves turn colored! That proves the water goes up.
t.s1425cd97a0: If a plant doesn't get enough water, its leaves go soft and droop — it wilts. If we water it quickly, it perks up again. But if it stays without water for a long time, the plant dries up.
t.s4bc12f36e7: We water a plant when the soil is dry. Too much water is bad too: the roots get no air and rot. Poke your finger into the soil: if it's dry, it's time to water!
t.s7a0fdc2b57: With a grown-up: pour water into a glass and add a few drops of food coloring. Put in a celery stalk with its leaves (or a white flower). Look the next day: the tips of the leaves have changed color! The water went up through the stem.
t.s94f551733b: How does a plant drink water?
t.sd96af93cc3: Right! The root soaks it up, the stem carries it.
t.s353ac92119: What happens to a plant without enough water?
t.s2658ce758c: Well done! Without water a plant wilts.
t.s5b83aa52ac: What happens if we pour too much water?
t.s9851aab500: Great job! We water just enough.
t.sc27029ca59: When is it time to water?
t.sf04c22988d: Right! We water when the soil is dry.
t.sc220f63e6f: Beep-beep! One day I put a flower pot in a dark room. A week later I looked — the leaves had turned yellow! Why did that happen?
t.s26c56fc656: A leaf needs sunlight to make food. Without light, the plant goes hungry and gets weak. That's why we put our house plants by the window.
t.s0f72c96ae4: Leaves are green because they have a special green stuff that catches light. In the dark there is less of it, and the leaves turn yellow. If we bring the plant back into the light, it turns green again!
t.sa28a4799c5: A flower on the windowsill slowly leans toward the Sun. The plant «feels» the light and reaches for it. If we turn the pot now and then, the flower grows straight.
t.sbd8fca962d: Take two sprouts that are the same (for example, beans). Put one on the windowsill and the other inside a cardboard box. Water them both the same. After a week, compare: the one in the box is yellow and thin, and the one by the window is green and strong!
t.s6178c6232a: What does a leaf need to make food?
t.s6e23e88434: What happens to leaves in the dark?
t.s95ef18f994: Well done! Without light a leaf turns yellow.
t.s7df543df83: Which way does the flower on the windowsill lean?
t.s520c99c9ad: Great job! The plant reaches for the Sun.
t.s886096c968: Right! The root soaks up water from the soil.
t.s453674fe91: Beep-beep! How does one tiny seed turn into a big fruit tree? Along the way it needs a little buzzing helper. Who is it?
t.s455e05e693: When a seed in the soil feels water and warmth, it wakes up and sprouts. First a little root grows down, then a sprout grows up. Inside the seed there is a food supply for the plant's first days!
t.sfff0227a44: A bee flies from flower to flower collecting nectar. Yellow pollen sticks to its body and goes to another flower — that's pollination. Where a flower is pollinated, a fruit grows!
t.s6952236b6c: A fruit grows where the flower was, and it has new seeds inside. Cut an apple, and you'll see tiny brown seeds. If we plant them, a new apple tree grows. The circle goes on!
t.s227b3412e8: Let's sing and move: «A tiny seed — we crouch down low. Rain falls, sun shines — we slowly grow. A flower opens — arms open wide. A bee comes by — buzz-buzz! The fruit is ripe — clap!»
t.s4de891a425: What does a seed need to wake up?
t.s26d6e0958a: Well done! The bee pollinates it.
t.sd0055aa3df: Great job! There are seeds inside a fruit.
t.sa6f031f520: Beep-beep! There is a special book with a bright red cover. The animals written in it need help, because very few of them are left. Let's open this book!
t.s769a1d42cf: The Red Book lists animals and plants that have become very few. Red means «Watch out! Danger!». Uzbekistan has its own Red Book too.
t.s1f2be1df66: Rare means you can hardly ever find it. Animals become fewer when people hunt them and when the forests and fields they live in are destroyed. Hunting animals from the Red Book is strictly forbidden!
t.s6e341abeb3: A nature reserve is a special place where nature is protected. No hunting or cutting down trees is allowed there, and animals live freely. Uzbekistan has nature reserves like Zarafshan and Chatkal.
t.s7dbd166dc6: Which animals go into the Red Book?
t.sb04a683109: Right! The ones that have become very few.
t.sedb075a2d6: Well done! Rare — something you seldom see.
t.s6383548ba7: What is not allowed in a nature reserve?
t.sed318e07fa: Great job! No hunting in a nature reserve.
t.s3c448dd72b: What does the colour red mean?
t.s98f3e8080b: Right! Red — a sign that says «careful».
t.s9c8ce7bd72: Beep-beep! In the thickets by the Amu Darya river lives a beautiful animal with antlers. And in the desert there is a slender animal that runs as fast as the wind. Both are in the Red Book!
t.s5f3ff8c068: The Bukhara deer lives in the thickets along the Amu Darya and Syr Darya rivers. The males have branching antlers that grow new every year. Once there were very few left, but thanks to nature reserves their number is growing again!
t.se7ebabe234: The goitered gazelle is a slender, quick animal that lives in the desert. It runs very fast — as fast as a car! It can go a long time without drinking water. In Bukhara, at the «Jeyran» eco-center, they are protected.
t.sde35503cf0: A tugai is a place by a river where reeds, oleaster and willows grow thick. Deer, pheasants and other animals live there. If we protect the tugai, the animals living there will stay safe too.
t.s10cda23975: Fold your paper in half. On one side draw the Bukhara deer in the thickets, on the other side the gazelle in the desert. At the top, let a grown-up help you write in red pencil: «I will protect you!»
t.s9aa5b56a4e: Where does the Bukhara deer live?
t.s68588a55ad: Right! In the thickets by the river.
t.s9b4955fc90: A slender animal that runs very fast in the desert?
t.sedbc5bad37: Well done! The gazelle is very fast.
t.sa41474fa6d: Great job! It's a forest by the river.
t.s94e565d635: A place where animals are protected?
t.s1c83a068db: Right! They are protected in a nature reserve.
t.sce41e013cc: Beep-beep! High in the mountains, among snow and rocks, lives a cat as hard to see as a ghost. Who is it? Seeing it is very good luck!
t.sfe2ca77543: The snow leopard (irbis) lives high in snowy mountains. Its fur is thick and spotted, and it wraps its long tail around its nose to keep warm in the cold! It is very careful, so people call it the «ghost of the mountains».
t.s674a688cbc: The markhor is a mountain goat with horns twisted like a drill. It moves nimbly on steep cliffs. In Uzbekistan the markhor lives in the Surkhandarya mountains and is listed in the Red Book.
t.s010a3e203d: The Tian Shan brown bear has light-coloured claws. It lives in mountain walnut forests and meadows and eats nuts, fruit and roots. In winter it sleeps in its den until spring.
t.s65d1da2d51: Everyone closes their eyes. One child — the snow leopard — quietly hides in the room. Robot Kabu: «Where is the ghost of the mountains?» Everyone opens their eyes and searches without a sound. Whoever finds the leopard becomes the next irbis!
t.s9f5a78fb53: Where does the snow leopard live?
t.sc9de1e55c0: What is another name for the snow leopard?
t.sd0fcadd14c: A mountain goat with twisted horns?
t.saffa848afa: Great job! The markhor has twisted horns.
t.s790927cf4e: What does a bear do in winter?
t.sdc1d55107e: Beep-beep! My winged relatives are in the Red Book too! And a big lizard that lives in the desert. Who are they, and how can we help them?
t.sc675352fc6: The black stork has black feathers and a red beak and legs. It catches fish and frogs by mountain streams. It is a very careful bird and builds its nest far away from people.
t.sf73d22ddbb: The monitor lizard is the biggest lizard in the deserts of Uzbekistan — longer than a metre! It hunts rodents and insects and keeps fields free of pests. The monitor lizard is in the Red Book too.
t.s210746f0da: To protect rare animals, we don't disturb them or wreck their nests. We don't leave litter in nature, and we plant trees. Even a little help does a lot of good!
t.s5a6e6abeda: Raise your hand and promise: «I won't wreck birds' nests! I won't scare animals! I won't leave litter in nature! I will protect the Red Book animals!» Congratulations, you are a little guardian of nature!
t.s32857205d6: What colour is the black stork's beak?
t.s77f9bb1ac0: Right! Its beak and legs are red.
t.saf4a8a397e: The biggest lizard in the desert?
t.sb2efa9d0c7: Well done! The desert monitor lizard.
t.s81f403e5fb: How do we help rare animals?
t.s4efa246822: Right! The irbis is a snow leopard.
t.sf874dc0729: Beep-beep! There is lots of water on Earth — the oceans are huge! So why do grown-ups say «save water»? Because there is very little clean water we can drink!
t.s0cac0c0f4d: Most of the water on Earth is salty sea water, and we can't drink it. Fresh water we can drink is very little — like one spoonful out of a whole bucket! That's why clean water is so precious.
t.s82c2a1bff9: Water from a river or from under the ground is cleaned at special plants. Then it travels through long pipes to our home. Many people worked hard for every drop from the tap!
t.s3993cf8895: A broken or open tap can drip enough water in one day to fill several buckets! If you see a dripping tap, tell a grown-up right away.
t.s9595a93d36: With a grown-up: open the tap so it drips very slowly and put a glass under it. After 10 minutes, look — how much water has collected! Now think: how much would it be in a whole day? Then we'll water the flowers with it — no wasting!
t.s22cf9c9dcf: Is there a lot of drinking water or a little?
t.s62f41f20a1: Well done! There is very little drinking water, and it's precious.
t.sa9e94dc5ed: What do we do if a tap is dripping?
t.se815007193: Great job! We tell a grown-up.
t.sf532c7a5a8: How does water get to our home?
t.safe8289e20: Right! It gets cleaned and comes through pipes.
t.s6b2ae2ef32: Beep-beep! You can be a water hero too! You don't need to do big things — little habits are enough. Let's learn three magic habits!
t.sa5c794b744: If we leave the tap running while brushing our teeth, lots of water flows away for nothing. If we fill a glass and turn off the tap, we save a whole bucket of water! It's the easiest habit.
t.s0132d96ccf: A full bath uses several times more water than a shower. A short shower saves water. You can turn off the water while you soap up.
t.s60893362db: We don't pour away the clean water used to wash fruit and vegetables — we water the flowers with it. You can also collect rainwater in a bucket to water the garden. Then every drop helps twice!
t.s68ea6c662f: Let's sing: «Turn it off, turn it off, save every drop, yeah! Brushing teeth — take a cup, be a water hero, yeah!» Every time you sing «off», twist your hand like you're turning off a tap!
t.sd9f744756b: How should the tap be while you brush your teeth?
t.s0c79787f2c: Right! We fill a glass and turn off the tap.
t.s23e6c5cac2: Well done! A short shower saves water.
t.s7676658cbb: What do we do with the water used to wash fruit?
t.s0a59424d6d: Great job! We water the flowers.
t.sc7d7642552: Right! There is very little fresh water.
t.s75f05c4d36: Beep-beep! Press a button — the light turns on, the fridge keeps cold, the TV works. This magic power comes from far away through wires. Where is it born?
t.sea4b85d057: Electricity is an invisible power that runs lamps, fridges and washing machines. It races very fast inside wires. Electricity is strong and dangerous, so we never play with wires or sockets!
t.sd239080275: At a power station, huge machines make electricity. Some stations use the power of river water, others burn fuel. Then electricity travels along wires on tall poles to the cities.
t.sffdb773e98: A solar panel turns sunlight straight into electricity. It makes no smoke and doesn't pollute nature. Uzbekistan has lots of sunny days, so there are more and more solar panels!
t.s9c6a1cff3e: What makes the light turn on?
t.se77282cc44: Right! Electricity turns on the light.
t.s2bdb1adcb6: Well done! At a power station.
t.s9018391b76: Can you play with a socket?
t.sbb04cbfa96: Right! Electricity is dangerous, we don't play with it.
t.s10f74de0a7: Beep-beep! You left the room, but the light stayed on. Who is it shining for? Nobody! Let's be electricity heroes!
t.s6eeb0ab0bd: When we leave a room, we switch off the light. In the daytime we open the curtains and use sunlight. Even one light switched off saves electricity!
t.s0819933662: A TV that nobody is watching still «eats» electricity. We switch off the TV, computer and toys when we're not using them. Reading a book instead of watching TV is good for you and saves energy too!
t.s80e6650601: Electricity is very strong and can hurt people. We never put fingers or things into a socket, and we don't touch switches with wet hands. If we see a broken wire, we stay away and tell a grown-up!
t.sa7b8fed1f5: This evening, walk around the house with a grown-up. Which room has nobody in it but the light is on? Which device is running for nothing? Found one — switch it off and draw yourself a star! How many stars did you collect?
t.s834df07ac1: What do we do when we leave a room?
t.se57cca935c: Right! We switch off the light.
t.sf0df11c710: A TV that nobody is watching?
t.sfb2dc4c2bf: Well done! We switch it off.
t.s15f6179851: Can you touch a switch with a wet hand?
t.s2c3a488ccd: Great job! Wet hands — that's dangerous.
t.s135c855aba: A source of electricity that makes no smoke?
t.s8d023f11e5: Right! A solar panel doesn't pollute nature.
t.se7375972c5: Beep-beep! I flew over Uzbekistan: on one side snowy mountains, on the other an endless sandy desert, and in the middle two great rivers! How beautiful our homeland is!
t.s86960adee2: In the east of Uzbekistan there are high mountains. On Chimgan mountain near Tashkent, people ski in winter and go hiking in summer. The snow in the mountains melts and fills our rivers with water.
t.s86b826a0d6: The Kyzylkum is the biggest desert in Uzbekistan. Its sand is reddish, and that's how it got its name. Camels, gazelles and monitor lizards live in the desert, and under the ground there are treasures like gold!
t.s8d119b9e91: The Amu Darya and the Syr Darya are the biggest rivers in Uzbekistan. They start in the mountains and give water to the fields. Thanks to this water, cotton, wheat, melons and grapes grow.
t.sf7a4286e8e: Mark three places in the room: mountains 🏔️ (step up on a chair), desert 🏜️ (the rug), river 🏞️ (a blue scarf). Robot Kabu says: «To Chimgan!» — go to the mountains. «To the Kyzylkum!» — walk like a camel. «To the Amu Darya!» — pretend to swim!
t.sf939f9beac: A mountain where people ski in winter?
t.s0d1121dc7e: The two big rivers of Uzbekistan?
t.s5bf53d0c62: What happens when the snow in the mountains melts?
t.s6efa208d9d: Right! The melted snow flows into the rivers.
t.sb6170d6197: Beep-beep! Today we travel to two famous cities! One is the capital of our country, the other is an ancient city more than 2750 years old. Let's go!
t.sbdd4d0dd31: Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan and its biggest city. It has a tall TV tower, big parks and a beautiful metro. The name «Tashkent» means «stone city».
t.s628234fb36: The metro is a fast train that runs under the ground. Every station of the Tashkent metro is decorated like a palace: patterns, lamps, pictures! The metro saves the city streets from traffic jams.
t.s629b3dafaf: Samarkand is one of the oldest cities in the world — more than 2750 years old. The three madrasas with blue domes on Registan Square are famous all over the world. There is also an observatory where Ulugbek studied the stars!
t.scc4c302fee: Which city is the capital of Uzbekistan?
t.scfa1801f93: A train that runs under the ground?
t.saee0d4374e: Which city is Registan Square in?
t.s3fd19573be: Who studied the stars in Samarkand?
t.sf3ea0c04b4: Beep-beep! Long ago, caravans loaded camels with silk, spices and china and set off on long journeys. Which fairy-tale cities did they stop at on the way?
t.s010f7ceb61: Bukhara is an ancient city with many mosques and madrasas. Its symbol is the Kalyan Minaret, which means «Great Minaret». It has stood for more than 800 years, and long ago it showed caravans the way like a lighthouse!
t.s1e2954c4b6: The old part of Khiva, Itchan Kala, is surrounded by high clay walls. Inside there are palaces, mosques and the Kalta Minor minaret covered in blue tiles. People call Khiva a «museum under the open sky»!
t.s66a8c9be3b: The Great Silk Road was an ancient trade route that stretched from China all the way to Europe. Caravans carried silk, spices and paper on camels. Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva were famous cities on this road!
t.sddd6e22afc: Everyone line up and hold the shoulders of the one in front — you're a camel caravan! Robot Kabu says a city's name, and the caravan «travels» there: «Samarkand — look at the Registan!», «Bukhara — look up at the minaret!», «Khiva — go inside the walls!»
t.s56611a1970: Which city is the Kalyan Minaret in?
t.sc20c98dc9f: Which city is Itchan Kala in?
t.sa967d54265: Which cities were on the Silk Road?
t.sc1afd72d57: Right! All three were on the Silk Road.
t.s08e47bed88: Beep-beep! In spring everything blooms, and something cooks in big pots all night long. And in autumn the streets are decorated with flags. What holidays are these?
t.sd64c4da852: Navruz is a spring holiday celebrated on 21 March; its name means «new day». On this day, day and night are the same length. People wish each other well, plant trees and visit their relatives.
t.s1737e58acc: Sumalak is made from wheat sprouts. It cooks in a big pot all night while people take turns stirring and singing songs. They make a wish and drop walnuts into the bottom of the pot!
t.s53fb416f09: Independence Day is celebrated every year on 1 September. Uzbekistan became an independent country in 1991. On this day cities are decorated with flags, and there are concerts and fireworks!
t.sba1a5150a4: Let's sing: «Sumalak bubbles in the pot, we take turns to stir a lot, spring is here, Navruz is here, every home is full of cheer!» Pretend you're holding a big ladle and stir round and round!
t.s1be3bc86e5: Beep-beep! In your body there is an organ as small as a fist, but it's the hardest worker of all. It hasn't rested for a single second since you were born! Did you guess?
t.s8778ffc053: The heart is a muscle about the size of your fist. Like a pump, it squeezes and pushes blood all around your body. Your heart beats more than 100 thousand times a day!
t.sd3e23cc8f0: Blood flows inside blood vessels and brings food and the air we breathe to the whole body. The vessels are like roads, and the blood is like trucks. The bluish lines on your wrist are your blood vessels!
t.sc3fae2c380: Put your fingers on your wrist and find your pulse!
t.sf2a6f8c3ff: A pulse is the beat of your heart that you feel in a blood vessel. You can feel it on your wrist or your neck. When you run, your muscles need more blood, so your heart beats faster.
t.sf8b3635389: Put your fingers on your wrist. A grown-up counts 10 seconds — you count the beats. Now jump in place 20 times and count again. When are there more beats? After jumping! Your heart worked harder.
t.s586f66c242: That's right! The heart is a pump.
t.s0c17ee89db: Well done! As big as your fist.
t.sc2ede325dd: Great job! Food and the air we breathe.
t.s11b327bf35: How does your heart beat when you run?
t.s64942f79e1: That's right! Your muscles need lots of blood.
t.s15232ae20f: Beep-beep! There are two soft «balloons» in your chest. When you breathe in — they get bigger, when you breathe out — they get smaller. What are they?
t.s75d6da4aca: The lungs are two soft organs in your chest. When we breathe in, they fill with air and puff up like a balloon. The lungs take the part of the air we need — oxygen — and give it to the blood.
t.sf563c9b2d0: Put your hand on your chest and take a deep breath!
t.se6fda88bc6: When we breathe in, fresh air goes through the nose into the lungs. When we breathe out, the used air goes back outside. We breathe more than 20 thousand times in one day!
t.s45f760aa94: Our lungs love fresh air. Walking and playing in the park makes the lungs strong. Smoke and dust hurt the lungs, so we stay away from smoky places.
t.se869ae97fe: Take a deep breath and blow up a balloon in one breath. How big did it get? That's some of the air from your lungs! Let a grown-up try too — whose balloon is bigger? Grown-ups have bigger lungs.
t.s9a93fb42d8: What happens to the lungs when we breathe in?
t.se5abe6a2d4: Well done! They fill with air and get bigger.
t.sa66e3fdf1f: What is good for the lungs?
t.s725a34f34e: Great job! Fresh air is good.
t.s305d21f4df: That's right! Blood flows through blood vessels.
t.se939945a59: Beep-beep! When you eat an apple, where does it go? It goes on an exciting trip inside your body! Let's follow the little apple.
t.s16831ca951: Chew well, like you're eating an apple!
t.sb2673a58a4: Food's trip starts in the mouth. Teeth break the food into small bits, and spit makes it soft. That's why we eat slowly and chew well!
t.s47362a0a78: When we swallow chewed food, it slides down a long tube — the food pipe — into the stomach. The stomach mixes it like a mixer and turns it into mush. Then the good stuff from the food goes into the blood and gives the body energy.
t.sd9e4b93429: Our body needs healthy food: vegetables, fruit, bread, milk, meat and beans. Too many sweets and fizzy drinks hurt your teeth and stomach. We wash our hands with soap before eating!
t.s419fe22302: You're a little apple! You go into the mouth — the teeth chew «crunch-crunch» (clap your hands). You slide down the food pipe (move your hands down). You spin in the stomach (turn around on the spot). Now you're energy! Show your muscles!
t.s1508805767: Which organ mixes food like a mixer?
t.s89d0a21ed5: That's right! We wash our hands with soap.
t.sbd7d71564d: Beep-beep! There's a «main boss» in your body. It gives orders to your heart, lungs, arms and legs, and reads the messages your eyes and ears send. Who is it?
t.s4bc3042981: The brain sits inside your skull and runs the whole body. We think, remember and talk — all thanks to the brain. While we sleep, the brain tidies up everything we learned that day!
t.se7b4e807b1: Eyes see colours and shapes around us and send a message to the brain. To take care of our eyes, we don't look at phones and TV for too long. And we don't rub our eyes with our hands!
t.sb636c029f1: Ears catch sounds and pass them to the brain. That's how we hear birds singing, music and Mum's voice. Very loud sounds hurt our ears, and we never put anything in our ears.
t.s7f96b78560: Close your eyes. A grown-up will make different sounds: rustling paper, a clinking spoon, a clap, a knock on the door. Guess each one! Your eyes were closed, but your ears sent the message to your brain — and your brain figured it out!
t.sd0e13d999e: That's right! The brain is the main boss.
t.s711f3c12ba: How do we take care of our ears?
t.s76b45d3c4f: That's right! The heart pumps blood.
t.sd6dc46f318: Beep-beep! I have a magic stone: it pulls nails and paper clips to itself, but it doesn't even notice wood or paper! What is this stone?
t.s868129f2a1: A magnet pulls things made of iron and steel. It doesn't pull wood, plastic, paper or glass. The pictures on the fridge door are held up by magnets too!
t.s350c006774: If we bring a magnet close to different things, we can find out which ones are made of iron. A paper clip, a nail and an iron spoon stick. An eraser, a pencil and paper don't.
t.s246e262c1e: Inside a compass there's a tiny magnetic needle. It always points north, because the Earth itself works like a giant magnet! Travellers and sailors find their way with a compass.
t.sdb8f309a7c: Put different things in a box: a paper clip, a coin, a pencil, an eraser, a nail, a lid, some paper. Test them with a magnet one by one. Put the ones that stick on one saucer and the ones that don't on another. Which pile has more?
t.s99b88f8d25: That's right! A magnet pulls iron.
t.sc9d6d36f0d: Which one doesn't stick to a magnet?
t.s79bd9c8c00: Well done! Wood doesn't get pulled.
t.s26fd043dc5: Which way does a compass point?
t.s3c9de43d69: What does the Earth work like?
t.s85231d111e: That's right! The Earth is like a giant magnet.
t.s9743b278d1: Beep-beep! On a sunny day a «friend» always walks next to you. You jump — it jumps too, you wave — it waves too. But on a cloudy day it disappears! Who is it?
t.s7e5da21dd9: Light travels in a straight line. When our body blocks the light, a dark spot appears behind us — a shadow. No light — no shadow!
t.s6ab9fca5f2: A light source is something that shines by itself: the Sun, a lamp, a torch, a candle. A shadow always falls on the side away from the light source. In the morning and evening shadows are long, and at midday they're short!
t.s1091fc1c08: If we hold our hands in different shapes in front of a lamp, a bunny, a bird or a dog shadow appears on the wall. Move your hand closer to the lamp — the shadow gets bigger, move it away — it gets smaller. That's a shadow theatre!
t.s529b8a51e6: In the evening, make the room dark and shine a torch on the wall. Use your hands to make a bunny (two fingers — ears), a bird (two palms — wings) and a dog. Put on a little show: «The bunny invited the little bird to visit...»
t.s7494cf2309: That's right! When something blocks the light.
t.s9162e80dac: Which one is a light source?
t.s9da6ecc892: Well done! A torch shines by itself.
t.s68fb58fa1b: If we move a hand closer to the lamp, the shadow...?
t.s6daf66ded7: Great job! The shadow gets bigger.
t.s41239b9f06: A mirror is a very smooth, shiny surface. It bounces the light back, like a ball bouncing off a wall. That's why we see ourselves in a mirror.
t.s290685522a: A mirror image is flipped: lift your right hand, and your reflection seems to lift its left one. That's why the word on the front of an ambulance is written backwards — the driver in front reads it the right way in the mirror!
t.s6dfe43f19e: If we hold a small mirror up to the Sun, a bright spot appears on the wall — a «sun bunny». Wiggle the mirror and it hops! But we never point the sun bunny into people's eyes.
t.seab54ffd6f: Get a partner and stand face to face. One of you is a person, the other is the mirror. The person moves slowly: lifts a hand, tilts their head, smiles. The mirror copies everything at the same time! Then swap roles.
t.s052f0a6421: Why do we see ourselves in a mirror?
t.s72b1b56644: That's right! A mirror bounces light back.
t.s23701a622c: If we lift our right hand, which one does the reflection lift?
t.sf6a8921712: Well done! The reflection is flipped.
t.sb73bd1b185: Where do we never point the sun bunny?
t.sb7d7095c31: Great job! Never into anyone's eyes.
t.s37ad527681: Beep-beep! After the rain the sun came out, and a colourful bridge appeared in the sky! It's the most beautiful secret in our book. Let's find it out together!
t.sf6d46f40f5: A rainbow appears after rain, when the Sun comes out. For that, the Sun has to be behind us and the raindrops in front of us. Sometimes you can see two rainbows at once!
t.sf504517eb0: A rainbow has seven colours: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet. They are always in this order. Red is at the very top, violet is at the very bottom!
t.s8698978947: Sunlight looks white, but really all the colours are hiding inside it! When light goes through a drop of water, the colours split apart and make a rainbow. That's why a soap bubble shimmers with colours too.
t.s680944ee59: On a sunny day, with a grown-up: put a glass of water on the edge of the windowsill and a sheet of white paper under it. The sunlight goes through the glass and draws a tiny rainbow on the paper! Or spray a fine mist from a hose in the yard and look with your back to the Sun.
t.s010600d65f: Let's sing: «Red and orange, yellow, green — in a rainbow row they're seen! Blue and indigo, violet too — seven colours, just for you!» Hold up one finger for each colour — that makes seven!
t.sa955dec932: That's right! We need rain and the Sun together.
t.s101a1d2545: How many colours are in a rainbow?
t.s27c7a8ed54: Which colour is at the very top of a rainbow?
t.sc438168101: Great job! Red is at the top.
t.s08073fd88c: Which colours are hiding in sunlight?
t.s175f8bea43: That's right! White light has all the colours.
t.s3d63dc2144: Beep-beep! Hello, kids! I'm robot Kabu. Look, there are apples on the tree. One for me, and the rest for you! Let's learn about one and many.
t.s0b268bcf78: Look, here's one apple. Let's show one finger: one! The apple is all alone — it's one.
t.sd4ae15514c: Now look, there are lots of apples in the basket. One, two, three, more, more… So many! Let's open our arms wide: many!
t.s33e71103f3: One finger — one, one! Lots of fingers — many, many, many! Come on, sing with me and show your fingers!
t.sc246099a7d: Show one finger. Now show all your fingers — many!

t.s3816f2024a: Beep-beep! Which side do we start reading a book from? From the left! We count things in a row from the left too. Let's try!
t.sd0a5eb821f: We start the row from the left side: first, second, third… We move to the right.
t.s005a1238e0: How many chicks? Four! Which place is the little chick in? Let's count from the left: first, second, third. It is third!
t.sa16d75a5b7: Count from the left: 🍎🍌🍐 — which one is second?
t.s787d86dd68: Well done! Second from the left is the banana.
t.s6f9fb7886b: Great job! Four chicks in all.
t.s2620528c63: Count from the left: 🐤🐤🐥🐤 — which place is the little chick in?
t.sb5707bea62: Count from the left: 🚗🚌🚲 — which one is first?
t.s997dab116f: Awesome! First from the left is the car.
t.sb98f638691: Beep-beep! The square has a relative. It also has four corners, but it's stretched out! Who is it? Look at the door!
t.sad628a9827: A door is a rectangle. Let's count the corners: one, two, three, four. Two sides are long, two are short.
t.s373c2a3ea2: A square has all sides the same. A rectangle is stretched out: one side is long, the other is short.
t.s5e9c15389c: A book, a phone, a window, a tabletop — they are all rectangles. What other rectangle can you find at home?
t.sa05239e289: Walk around your home and find rectangle things: a door, a window, a book… How many did you find? Count on your fingers!
t.s179c11bd80: Draw a rectangle on paper and turn it into a door.
t.s355bad0e42: Well done! A door is a rectangle.
t.sbcec68e158: Which shape has all sides the same?
t.s78fe752a1b: Great job! A square has equal sides.
t.s0cb91fc6a2: What shape does a book look like?
t.sa55bde0fb8: Right! A book is a rectangle.
t.sfea59afe90: How many corners does a rectangle have?
t.s730740bbb9: Beep-beep! There's something in my nest. It looks like a circle, but stretched out. What is it? An egg! Its shape is an oval.
t.sd3d70a4f05: Look at the egg. It's round with no corners, but stretched out. This shape is an oval.
t.s1ccf5472d3: A circle is equally round on all sides. An oval looks like a stretched circle. Neither one has corners.
t.sd120c03332: A rugby ball, a potato, a watermelon — they all look like an oval. Come on, find something else that's oval!
t.sd6f04bf897: Well done! An egg is an oval.
t.s0baadc748f: Great job! A circle is evenly round.
t.sbc173d2c79: How many corners does an oval have?
t.s33e97dd9d4: Right! An oval has no corners.
t.s53ef61103c: Beep-beep! I looked at the traffic light: red, yellow, green. What if we string beads the same way? A three-color pattern — a new secret!
t.s828fccf9c7: Red, yellow, green — then again red, yellow, green. The three colors repeat in turn. This is a three-color pattern.
t.saf082cbc5a: In a pattern one part repeats again and again: red-yellow-green. Once we find that part, it's easy to say what comes next!
t.sea4d2a2b16: Clap, knees, jump! Clap, knees, jump! Three moves make one part of the pattern. Let's repeat it three times!
t.s79291606bb: Make a sound pattern: moo, meow, woof!
t.s49f16f635a: Well done! After yellow comes green.
t.sa6ffdcf933: Great job! After red comes yellow.
t.s8e0720a8c9: 🔴🟡🟢🔴🟡🟢 — how many colors are in one part of the pattern?
t.s025b0c8478: Beep-beep! A doll came out of a doll, and another doll came out of that one! How should we line them up?
t.s202c38c214: Here is the biggest doll. It is bigger than all the others. It stands first in the row.
t.s7470dd74e8: Here is the smallest doll. It is smaller than all the others and fits in your palm. It stands last in the row.
t.s54bf1408c7: An elephant, a dog, a mouse. We start with the biggest, and each next one is smaller. Now they're in order!
t.s650acdf23e: Take some bowls or little boxes at home. Put the biggest one first, then a smaller one, then the smallest. Are they in order?
t.s941848dcb3: Compare two things: which is bigger?
t.sdc9a7d2a12: Line them up from the smallest to the biggest.
t.s88132d2f89: Well done! The elephant is the biggest.
t.se62dba339d: Great job! The mouse is the smallest.
t.s19afbc0183: Which row goes from biggest to smallest?
t.s20560df348: 🐘🐕🐭 — what place is the middle one in?
t.s3d226b2456: Beep-beep! My pencils got scattered: one is long, another is short. If we line them up like stairs, it'll look nice. Will you help me?
t.sc829bd1991: We line up the pencils at one end. The one that reaches the farthest is the longest. We put it first.
t.sa0ee9a6c8e: The pencil that ends the soonest is the shortest. It goes at the end of the row.
t.s7b991efd5b: Long, shorter, even shorter, shortest. The pencils look like a staircase!
t.s7ddcb4dcf9: Well done! This ribbon is the longest.
t.sb912200faa: Great job! This ribbon is the shortest.
t.s26dc8fcefa: What do we do when we compare length?
t.sc0155054fc: Beep-beep! We built five towers out of blocks. If we line them up from short to tall, we get a staircase. Let's count!
t.sd9abcb939f: The shortest tower has one block, the next has two, then three, four, five. Each one is one block taller!
t.sb503701d74: In the middle of the five towers stands the third one. There are two on its left and two on its right.
t.s74cb719e4e: Build five towers from blocks: one in the first, two in the second… five in the fifth. Did you get a staircase? Walk a doll up the steps!
t.scbbfe83e35: Build three towers: one, two, three blocks.
t.s8fe59946d3: Line up your family members by height.
t.s7e19311ab5: Towers from short to tall: 1, 2, 3, 4… how many blocks in the next one?
t.s5a739029a9: Well done! The next one has five blocks.
t.s6b4823075a: What place is the middle tower of the five?
t.s9c63cf5a83: Great job! The third one is in the middle.
t.s000f8f8aae: Awesome! The turtle is the shortest.
t.s13385a6c11: Beep-beep! The rooster called: cluck-cluck-cluck! The sun came up. I woke up and stretched. How does the day begin? Let's find out!
t.s7e8aecb76f: In the morning the sun comes up. We wake up, wash, have breakfast and go to kindergarten.
t.sada9932a25: In the daytime the sun is high in the sky. Everything is bright. We play, have lunch and go for a walk.
t.sc95a105115: Well done! We wake up in the morning.
t.s4344e62467: The sun is high in the sky. When is that?
t.sc7de47579c: Beep-beep! The sun is setting, and the sky is bright red. Then it gets dark and the stars come out. What are these times called?
t.s09388fb66f: In the evening the sun sets. Our family gathers at home, we have dinner and read a story.
t.sb4a12ab346: At night it's dark, and the moon and stars come out. Everyone sleeps and gets their strength back.
