t.s4a6ae867cf: The child connects cause and effect and explains the order of events
t.s6b0b00020f: Beep-beep! Everything has a cause! If something happens — what happens next? Let's think like scientists!
t.sd5e992d820: If we put ice in a warm place, it melts and turns into water. If we leave water out in the freezing cold, it turns into ice.
t.sdec0c5f15e: The ice melts into water. This is the effect: it happened because of the cause.
t.s1711ad680d: 🧊 + ☀️ ➡️ ❓ What happens to ice in the sun?
t.s82540818e6: Super! The ice melts into water.
t.s898de1d795: 💧 + ❄️ ➡️ ❓ What happens to water in the freezing cold?
t.s110f5fa34d: ❄️ + ☀️ ➡️ ❓ What happens to snow in spring?
t.s77b0519504: Super! The snow melts into a puddle.
t.s81ba69b67b: An experiment with a grown-up! Put an ice cube on a plate by the window. Check every 10 minutes: what is happening? Why?
t.s7ae52caa3c: When it rains, puddles appear and plants drink water. When there is rain and sun together, a rainbow appears in the sky!
t.s2719104c7c: A rainbow appears! This is the effect: it happened because of the cause.
t.s7b769cf357: 🌧️ ➡️ ❓ What is on the road after rain?
t.s29ffb2731b: 🌷 + 🚫💧 ➡️ ❓ What happens if we don't water a flower?
t.sd16bc662ec: In spring the tree blossoms. Where the flower was, a little green apple appears. All summer it ripens in the sun and turns red.
t.sd505c9c82e: A ripe red apple! This is the effect: it happened because of the cause.
t.s5b05a7b301: Great job! A ripe red apple!
t.s9007549753: Well done! First the apple blossom opens.
t.s27d2bf1e29: Super! First a sprout comes out of the seed.
t.se7630ef1f3: In the morning we wake up, brush our teeth, have breakfast and go to kindergarten. In the evening we take a bath and go to sleep. Everything has its time!
t.sde992c8910: We have breakfast! This is the effect: it happened because of the cause.
t.s6db9763f42: 🍳 ➡️ ❓ Where do we go after breakfast?
t.s36dae38f8e: Super! We take our backpack and go to kindergarten.
t.s473957b26a: 🌙 ➡️ ❓ What do we do at night?
t.s358a771496: Well done! At night we sleep.
t.sf3e53c34b7: “If” and “then” are magic words. If we kick a ball, then it rolls. If we blow into a balloon, then it gets big. If we run a lot, then we get tired.
t.s4a668eaf98: The balloon gets bigger. This is the effect: it happened because of the cause.
t.sc08779f9ca: If we blow into a balloon, then it... ❓
t.s6db4d48664: If it gets dark, then in the sky... ❓
t.sbab5b2b75b: Well done! The moon and stars come out.
t.sccb0107d92: If a hen sits on an egg, then... ❓
t.s0f1aa4a846: A butterfly starts as a tiny egg. A caterpillar comes out and eats lots of leaves. Then it wraps itself in a cocoon, sleeps and flies out as a butterfly!
t.s8a1c5791ba: It becomes a butterfly! This is the effect: it happened because of the cause.
t.sad6d3c8dd3: 🥚 ➡️ 🐛 ➡️ ❓ What does it become at the end?
t.scbe3e265c8: Great job! First a tiny egg.
t.sebc15ed953: Great job! The caterpillar eats leaves.
t.s5efd2a3a84: The child solves simple logic puzzles step by step
t.s49707d0872: Beep-beep! Today we exercise our brain! No rushing — we listen carefully to every word and think.
t.s9cecdfcc11: A chain of comparisons: if Ali is taller than Vali, and Vali is taller than Sara, then Ali is the tallest! We think step by step.
t.s36cdce542c: Put your finger on your temple and say “I'm thinking!”
t.sd319524353: we think one step at a time
t.s6be187286a: We split a hard question into parts: first we think about the first sentence, then the second. At the end the answer appears by itself!
t.s02c68b7f55: Ali is taller than Vali. Vali is taller than Sara. Who is the tallest?
t.s43d3dabcbe: Sara is shorter than Ali. Ali is shorter than Vali. Who is the shortest?
t.s1bf41081db: Great job! Sara is the shortest.
t.s13cd795e07: 🐘 is bigger than a horse. 🐴 is bigger than a bear. Who is bigger: the elephant or the bear?
t.sb6a46db448: Game! Think of something and say three things about it. Let your family guess! Then they give you a riddle.
t.s3a95b5df46: In this game we cross out the places where it's “not”. The place that's left is the answer!
t.s5f9ddd3259: The cat is not in the box. It's not in the basket either. Where is the cat?
t.s0ddd4081ed: Awesome! The only place left is under the bed!
t.s2cf016f47c: The ball is not on the chair. It's not on the bed. Where is the ball?
t.s71d7351c13: Super! The ball is in the box!
t.s96d8ff3428: The bunny is not behind the tree. It's not in the house. Where is the bunny?
t.s4f0f8c2902: Super! The bunny is among the flowers!
t.s6e1f888fc7: If “all birds have wings” and a sparrow is a bird, then a sparrow has wings too. That's logic!
t.sb6997a6d4e: All birds have wings. An owl is a bird. Does an owl have wings?
t.sc651691bda: Super! Yes, an owl has wings.
t.sec4cf55c9e: All fish live in water. A cat is not a fish. Does a cat live in water?
t.se73e60478c: Right! No, a cat lives on land.
t.s1b098bc6d5: All fruits grow on trees or bushes. An apple is a fruit. Does an apple grow?
t.s96777f01fe: Super! Yes, an apple grows on a tree.
t.s8bfa39fe95: Logical counting: one bird has two legs. Two birds have twice as many: four legs! We picture it in our head and count.
t.sccc11ef6fe: 🐦🐦 How many legs do two birds have?
t.sd1015e7bca: 🐱🐱 How many ears do two cats have?
t.s9f8a49e5ba: 🖐️🖐️ How many fingers on two hands?
t.s6530b20199: The heavy side of the scales goes down and the light side goes up. Whichever side is lower is heavier!
t.see623849fa: ⚖️ 🍉 is down, 🍒 is up. Which is heavier?
t.s830f133a87: Great job! The watermelon is heavier — it went down.
t.s3358e9e087: ⚖️ 🪶 is up, 🪨 is down. Which is lighter?
t.sc1fc8ceba9: Right! The feather is lighter — it went up.
t.s44ff3d2c2c: ⚖️ 🍎 and 🍎 are level. What does that mean?
t.s4232a0133d: Awesome! The scales are level — they weigh the same.
t.s076b47cb09: A riddle tells you the features of something. We listen to each feature and cross out what doesn't fit. At the end one answer is left!
t.sbfe24f92e2: Long ears, it hops, it eats carrots. Who is it?
t.s4045a7c247: In the sky by day, warm and bright. What is it?
t.scfcb9f2ed8: A very long neck, it eats leaves from trees. Who is it?
